entry.summary: Proposes LESA, a learnable stage-aware predictor framework using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for accelerating diffusion transformers by learning temporal feature evolution across diffusion stages.

entry.title: UrbanFM: Scaling Urban Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models

author.name: Wei Chen, Yuqian Wu, Junle Chen, Xiaofang Zhou, Yuxuan Liang

entry.summary: Proposes UrbanFM, a spatio-temporal foundation model for urban systems that investigates scaling along three dimensions: heterogeneity, dynamics, and spatial extent, inspired by foundation model success in genomics and meteorology.

entry.title: See and Fix the Flaws: Enabling VLMs and Diffusion Models to Comprehend Visual Artifacts via Agentic Data Synthesis

author.name: Jaehyun Park, Minyoung Ahn, Minkyu Kim, Jonghyun Lee, Jae-Gil Lee, Dongmin Park

entry.summary: Proposes ArtiAgent, an agentic framework that automatically creates pairs of real and artifact-injected images for training VLMs and diffusion models to comprehend and fix visual artifacts, bypassing the need for costly human annotation.

entry.title: Cooperative-Competitive Team Play of Real-World Craft Robots

author.name: Rui Zhao, Xihui Li, Yizheng Zhang, Yuzhen Liu, Zhong Zhang, Yufeng Zhang, Cheng Zhou, Zhengyou Zhang, Lei Han

entry.summary: Develops a comprehensive robotic system for cooperative-competitive team play of real craft robots, using multi-agent RL with sim-to-real transfer techniques including Out of Distribution State Initialization.

entry.title: QuantVLA: Scale-Calibrated Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Jingxuan Zhang, Yunta Hsieh, Zhongwei Wang, Haokun Lin, Xin Wang, Ziqi Wang, Yingtie Lei, Mi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces QuantVLA, the first post-training quantization framework for Vision-Language-Action models, including quantization of diffusion transformer action heads. Uses three scale-calibrated components for efficient deployment of embodied agents.

entry.title: cc-Shapley: Measuring Multivariate Feature Importance Needs Causal Context

author.name: J\"org Martin, Stefan Haufe

entry.summary: Proposes cc-Shapley, which incorporates causal context into Shapley value-based feature importance to avoid spurious attributions from collider bias and suppression effects that arise in purely data-driven approaches.

entry.title: The Diffusion Duality, Chapter II: $\Psi$-Samplers and Efficient Curriculum

author.name: Justin Deschenaux, Caglar Gulcehre, Subham Sekhar Sahoo

entry.summary: Introduces Ψ-Samplers, a family of Predictor-Corrector samplers for discrete diffusion that generalize prior methods and improve quality of uniform-state discrete diffusion as steps increase, achieving better perplexity and FID scores.

entry.title: Statistical Query Lower Bounds for Smoothed Agnostic Learning

author.name: Ilias Diakonikolas, Daniel M. Kane

entry.summary: Proves SQ lower bounds for smoothed agnostic learning of halfspaces, showing the existing upper bound of d^{Õ(1/σ²)·log(1/ε)} is near-optimal, providing formal evidence that the exponential dependence on 1/σ² is necessary.

entry.title: Benchmarking Distilled Language Models: Performance and Efficiency in Resource-Constrained Settings

author.name: Sachin Gopal Wani, Eric Page, Ajay Dholakia, David Ellison

entry.summary: Benchmarks distilled language models against vanilla and proprietary counterparts, finding distilled 8B models are 2000x more compute-efficient to create while matching models 10x their size in reasoning.

entry.title: LUMEN: Longitudinal Multi-Modal Radiology Model for Prognosis and Diagnosis

author.name: Zhifan Jiang, Dong Yang, Vishwesh Nath, Abhijeet Parida, Nishad P. Kulkarni, Ziyue Xu, Daguang Xu, Syed Muhammad Anwar, Holger R. Roth, Marius George Linguraru

entry.summary: Introduces LUMEN, a training framework for longitudinal multi-modal radiology that enables both diagnosis and prognosis from temporal chest X-ray sequences. Uses vision-language models with a VQA interface for radiologist decision support.

entry.title: Overton Pluralistic Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models

author.name: Yu Fu, Seongho Son, Ilija Bogunovic

entry.summary: Introduces OP-GRPO, a reinforcement learning framework enabling a single LLM to produce pluralistic responses reflecting diverse perspectives without explicit prompting. Uses a fine-tuned similarity estimator for coverage evaluation.

entry.title: Linear Reasoning vs. Proof by Cases: Obstacles for Large Language Models in FOL Problem Solving

author.name: Yuliang Ji, Fuchen Shen, Jian Wu, Qiujie Xie, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PC-FOL, a first-order logic dataset focusing on proof by cases (non-linear reasoning), revealing that LLMs struggle significantly with case-based reasoning compared to linear proofs. All instances include manually written natural language proofs.

entry.title: 3DSPA: A 3D Semantic Point Autoencoder for Evaluating Video Realism

author.name: Bhavik Chandna, Kelsey R. Allen

entry.summary: Develops 3DSPA, a 3D spatiotemporal point autoencoder for automatically evaluating video realism without reference videos. Integrates 3D trajectories, depth, and DINO features to assess both semantic and structural coherence.

entry.title: SimLBR: Learning to Detect Fake Images by Learning to Detect Real Images

author.name: Aayush Dhakal, Subash Khanal, Srikumar Sastry, Jacob Arndt, Philipe Ambrozio Dias, Dalton Lunga, Nathan Jacobs

entry.summary: Proposes SimLBR for fake image detection by learning a tight boundary around real image distribution using Latent Blending Regularization, treating fakes as out-of-distribution. Achieves +24.85% cross-generator accuracy improvement.

entry.title: The Finite Primitive Basis Theorem for Computational Imaging: Formal Foundations of the OperatorGraph Representation

author.name: Chengshuai Yang

entry.summary: Proves the Finite Primitive Basis Theorem: every computational imaging forward model can be approximated by a DAG of exactly 11 canonical primitives. Provides a constructive algorithm for decomposition.

entry.title: AIForge-Doc: A Benchmark for Detecting AI-Forged Tampering in Financial and Form Documents

author.name: Jiaqi Wu, Yuchen Zhou, Muduo Xu, Zisheng Liang, Simiao Ren, Jiayu Xue, Meige Yang, Siying Chen, Jingheng Huan

entry.summary: Introduces AIForge-Doc, the first benchmark specifically targeting diffusion-model-based document forgery detection with pixel-level annotation. Uses Gemini 2.5 Flash and Ideogram for generating forged financial documents across 9 languages.

entry.title: From Pairs to Sequences: Track-Aware Policy Gradients for Keypoint Detection

author.name: Yepeng Liu, Hao Li, Liwen Yang, Fangzhen Li, Xudi Ge, Yuliang Gu, kuang Gao, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Yongchao Xu

entry.summary: TraqPoint reframes keypoint detection as a sequential decision-making problem, using reinforcement learning to optimize long-term track quality across image sequences rather than just pairwise matching. This addresses a gap where pair-trained detectors fail to maintain consistent tracks.

entry.title: LongVideo-R1: Smart Navigation for Low-cost Long Video Understanding

author.name: Jihao Qiu, Lingxi Xie, Xinyue Huo, Qi Tian, Qixiang Ye

entry.summary: LongVideo-R1 proposes an active reasoning-equipped MLLM agent for efficient long video understanding under low computational budgets, using hierarchical visual summaries and iterative focus refinement to avoid exhaustive search.

entry.title: Spa3R: Predictive Spatial Field Modeling for 3D Visual Reasoning

author.name: Haoyi Jiang, Liu Liu, Xinjie Wang, Yonghao He, Wei Sui, Zhizhong Su, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang

entry.summary: Spa3R introduces self-supervised spatial field prediction for 3D visual reasoning in VLMs, arguing spatial intelligence can emerge from 2D vision alone without explicit spatial instruction tuning.

entry.title: The ML ontology and the alignment ontology

author.name: Richard_Ngo

entry.summary: Richard Ngo reflects on the gap between the alignment community's ontology (mesa-optimizers, situational awareness, corrigibility) and the ML community's ontology, discussing how this gap has complicated engagement and how alignment concepts are now becoming more legible.

entry.title: CAGE: A Framework for Culturally Adaptive Red-Teaming Benchmark Generation

author.name: Chaeyun Kim, YongTaek Lim, Kihyun Kim, Junghwan Kim, Minwoo Kim

entry.summary: Introduces CAGE, a framework for culturally adapting red-teaming benchmarks using 'Semantic Molds' that separate adversarial structure from cultural content. Demonstrates with KoRSET for Korean.

entry.title: IG-RFT: An Interaction-Guided RL Framework for VLA Models in Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Zhian Su, Weijie Kong, Haonan Dong, Huixu Dong

entry.summary: IG-RFT proposes Interaction-Guided Reinforced Fine-Tuning for flow-based VLA models, addressing exploration efficiency and training stability challenges when applying RL to real-world VLA fine-tuning for long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: A Benchmark for Deep Information Synthesis

author.name: Debjit Paul, Daniel Murphy, Milan Gritta, Ronald Cardenas, Victor Prokhorov, Lena Sophia Bolliger, Aysim Toker, Roy Miles, Andreea-Maria Oncescu, Jasivan Alex Sivakumar, Philipp Borchert, Ismail Elezi, Meiru Zhang, Ka Yiu Lee, Guchun Zhang, Jun Wang, Gerasimos Lampouras

entry.summary: Introduces DEEPSYNTH, a benchmark of 120 tasks across 7 domains evaluating LLM agents on realistic information synthesis tasks requiring gathering, synthesis, and structured reasoning from multiple sources.

entry.title: KnapSpec: Self-Speculative Decoding via Adaptive Layer Selection as a Knapsack Problem

author.name: Seongjin Cha, Gyuwan Kim, Dongsu Han, Tao Yang, Insu Han

entry.summary: Proposes KnapSpec, a training-free self-speculative decoding framework that reformulates draft model selection as a knapsack problem, adapting to context length by decoupling attention and MLP latencies.

entry.title: Squint: Fast Visual Reinforcement Learning for Sim-to-Real Robotics

author.name: Abdulaziz Almuzairee, Henrik I. Christensen

entry.summary: Introduces Squint, a visual reinforcement learning method based on Soft Actor-Critic that achieves faster wall-clock training than prior methods through parallel simulation, distributional critic, and resolution squinting techniques for sim-to-real robotics.

entry.title: VGGDrive: Empowering Vision-Language Models with Cross-View Geometric Grounding for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jie Wang, Guang Li, Zhijian Huang, Chenxu Dang, Hangjun Ye, Yahong Han, Long Chen

entry.summary: VGGDrive infuses VLMs with cross-view geometric grounding from 3D foundation models for autonomous driving, addressing the fundamental lack of 3D geometric reasoning in current VLMs. Proposes architectural integration rather than just Q&A data augmentation.

entry.title: An artificial intelligence framework for end-to-end rare disease phenotyping from clinical notes using large language models

author.name: Cathy Shyr, Yan Hu, Rory J. Tinker, Thomas A. Cassini, Kevin W. Byram, Rizwan Hamid, Daniel V. Fabbri, Adam Wright, Josh F. Peterson, Lisa Bastarache, Hua Xu

entry.summary: Introduces RARE-PHENIX, an end-to-end AI framework using LLMs for rare disease phenotyping from clinical notes, integrating phenotype extraction, HPO standardization, and diagnostic ranking. Addresses a real clinical workflow gap.

entry.title: Grounding LLMs in Scientific Discovery via Embodied Actions

author.name: Bo Zhang, Jinfeng Zhou, Yuxuan Chen, Jianing Yin, Minlie Huang, Hongning Wang

entry.summary: Proposes EmbodiedAct, a framework that transforms scientific software (MATLAB) into active embodied agents by grounding LLMs in a tight perception-execution loop for engineering design and scientific modeling tasks.

entry.title: PyVision-RL: Forging Open Agentic Vision Models via RL

author.name: Shitian Zhao, Shaoheng Lin, Ming Li, Haoquan Zhang, Wenshuo Peng, Kaipeng Zhang, Chen Wei

entry.summary: Introduces PyVision-RL, a reinforcement learning framework for open-weight multimodal models that prevents interaction collapse through oversampling-filtering-ranking and accumulative tool rewards.

entry.title: MoBiQuant: Mixture-of-Bits Quantization for Token-Adaptive Elastic LLMs

author.name: Dongwei Wang, Jinhee Kim, Seokho Han, Denis Gudovskiy, Yohei Nakata, Tomoyuki Okuno, KhayTze Peong, Kang Eun Jeon, Jong Hwan Ko, Yiran Chen, Huanrui Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MoBiQuant, a Mixture-of-Bits quantization framework for elastic LLM deployment that adapts precision per-token based on outlier sensitivity, reformulating calibration as precision-agnostic.

entry.title: InterviewSim: A Scalable Framework for Interview-Grounded Personality Simulation

author.name: Yu Li, Pranav Narayanan Venkit, Yada Pruksachatkun, Chien-Sheng Wu

entry.summary: Introduces InterviewSim, a large-scale framework for evaluating personality simulation in LLMs using 671K+ Q&A pairs from 23K verified interview transcripts of 1K public personalities. Proposes multi-dimensional evaluation with four complementary metrics for content similarity and factual consistency.

entry.title: VINA: Variational Invertible Neural Architectures

author.name: Shubhanshu Shekhar, Mohammad Javad Khojasteh, Ananya Acharya, Tony Tohme, Kamal Youcef-Toumi

entry.summary: Introduces VINA, a unified framework for invertible neural networks and normalizing flows with theoretical guarantees on approximation quality under realistic assumptions, based on variational unsupervised loss functions.

entry.title: Echoes Over Time: Unlocking Length Generalization in Video-to-Audio Generation Models

author.name: Christian Simon, MAsato Ishii, Wei-Yao Wang, Koichi Saito, Akio Hayakawa, Dongseok Shim, Zhi Zhong, Shuyang Cui, Shusuke Takahashi, Takashi Shibuya, Yuki Mitsufuji

entry.summary: Presents MMHNet for video-to-audio generation that enables length generalization, allowing models trained on short clips to generate audio for 5+ minute videos using hierarchical networks and non-causal Mamba.

entry.title: SparkMe: Adaptive Semi-Structured Interviewing for Qualitative Insight Discovery

author.name: David Anugraha, Vishakh Padmakumar, Diyi Yang

entry.summary: Formulates adaptive semi-structured interviewing as an optimization problem, balancing systematic coverage of predefined topics with adaptive exploration and emergent theme pursuit in LLM-conducted interviews.

entry.title: In-context Pre-trained Time-Series Foundation Models adapt to Unseen Tasks

author.name: Shangqing Xu, Harshavardhan Kamarthi, Haoxin Liu, B. Aditya Prakash

entry.summary: Proposes ICTP, a framework that augments time-series foundation models with in-context learning capabilities by restructuring pre-training data, enabling adaptation to unseen tasks without fine-tuning.

entry.title: Probing Dec-POMDP Reasoning in Cooperative MARL

author.name: Kale-ab Tessera, Leonard Hinckeldey, Riccardo Zamboni, David Abel, Amos Storkey

entry.summary: Introduces a diagnostic suite for auditing whether cooperative MARL benchmarks actually require Dec-POMDP reasoning (history-based inference and decentralized coordination) or allow simpler strategies.

entry.title: SELAUR: Self Evolving LLM Agent via Uncertainty-aware Rewards

author.name: Dengjia Zhang, Xiaoou Liu, Lu Cheng, Yaqing Wang, Kenton Murray, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Introduces SELAUR, an RL framework for LLM agents that incorporates uncertainty-based rewards (entropy, least-confidence, margin metrics) into token-level reward design for multi-step decision making.

entry.title: OrgFlow: Generative Modeling of Organic Crystal Structures from Molecular Graphs

author.name: Mohammadmahdi Vahediahmar, Matthew A. McDonald, Feng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces OrgFlow, a flow-matching model for predicting organic crystal structures from molecular graphs, with bond-aware loss to enforce realistic local chemistry and periodic boundary conditions.

entry.title: Detecting and Mitigating Group Bias in Heterogeneous Treatment Effects

author.name: Joel Persson, Jurri\"en Bakker, Dennis Bohle, Stefan Feuerriegel, Florian von Wangenheim

entry.summary: Shows that aggregating individual-level CATE predictions to group level can induce systematic bias, even with correctly specified models and randomized experiment data. Proposes detection and mitigation strategies.

entry.title: SpatiaLQA: A Benchmark for Evaluating Spatial Logical Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yuechen Xie, Xiaoyan Zhang, Yicheng Shan, Hao Zhu, Rui Tang, Rong Wei, Mingli Song, Yuanyu Wan, Jie Song

entry.summary: Introduces SpatiaLQA, a benchmark for evaluating spatial logical reasoning in vision-language models, testing both spatial relationship understanding and multi-step logical dependencies in complex scenes.

entry.title: PaperTrail: A Claim-Evidence Interface for Grounding Provenance in LLM-based Scholarly Q&A

author.name: Anna Martin-Boyle, Cara A. C. Leckey, Martha C. Brown, Harmanpreet Kaur

entry.summary: Introduces PaperTrail, an interface that decomposes LLM answers and source documents into claim-evidence mappings for scholarly QA, revealing supported assertions, unsupported claims, and omissions. Evaluated with 26 researchers.

entry.title: Multi-Vector Index Compression in Any Modality

author.name: Hanxiang Qin, Alexander Martin, Rohan Jha, Chunsheng Zuo, Reno Kriz, Benjamin Van Durme

entry.summary: Studies efficient multi-vector retrieval compression for late interaction across any modality. Introduces four approaches including attention-guided clustering (AGC) for compressing document representations under a constant vector budget.

entry.title: Probing and Bridging Geometry-Interaction Cues for Affordance Reasoning in Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Qing Zhang, Xuesong Li, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Probes Visual Foundation Models for affordance reasoning, finding that DINO encodes geometric structures while Flux contains verb-conditioned interaction priors. Shows these are composable for affordance understanding.

entry.title: BBQ-to-Image: Numeric Bounding Box and Qolor Control in Large-Scale Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Eliran Kachlon, Alexander Visheratin, Nimrod Sarid, Tal Hacham, Eyal Gutflaish, Saar Huberman, Hezi Zisman, David Ruppin, Ron Mokady

entry.summary: BBQ introduces numeric bounding box and RGB color control directly into text-to-image generation through structured-text conditioning, without architectural modifications. This bridges the gap between descriptive language prompts and precise parametric control needed in professional workflows.

entry.title: TextPecker: Rewarding Structural Anomaly Quantification for Enhancing Visual Text Rendering

author.name: Hanshen Zhu, Yuliang Liu, Xuecheng Wu, An-Lan Wang, Hao Feng, Dingkang Yang, Chao Feng, Can Huang, Jingqun Tang, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: TextPecker proposes a structural anomaly perceptive RL strategy for visual text rendering, finding that leading MLLMs and OCR models fail to detect structural anomalies in rendered text. Creates a plug-and-play reward model for any T2I generator.

entry.title: Are Multimodal Large Language Models Good Annotators for Image Tagging?

author.name: Ming-Kun Xie, Jia-Hao Xiao, Zhiqiang Kou, Zhongnian Li, Gang Niu, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Analyzes whether MLLMs can replace human annotators for image tagging, finding they can reduce annotation cost to one-thousandth while revealing systematic gaps. Proposes solutions to bridge MLLM-human annotation differences.

entry.title: Smoothly Differentiable and Efficiently Vectorizable Contact Manifold Generation

author.name: Onur Beker, Andreas Ren\'e Geist, Anselm Paulus, Nico G\"urtler, Ji Shi, Sylvain Calinon, Georg Martius

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for smoothly differentiable and efficiently vectorizable contact manifold generation for rigid-body simulation, designed from scratch for GPU vectorization and differentiability.

entry.title: Inner Speech as Behavior Guides: Steerable Imitation of Diverse Behaviors for Human-AI coordination

author.name: Rakshit Trivedi, Kartik Sharma, David C Parkes

entry.summary: Proposes MIMIC, a framework using language as internal 'inner speech' representation of behavioral intent for human-AI coordination. Draws from cognitive science to enable steerable, diverse imitation learning.

entry.title: PromptCD: Test-Time Behavior Enhancement via Polarity-Prompt Contrastive Decoding

author.name: Baolong Bi, Yuyao Ge, Shenghua Liu, Yuchen He, Siqian Tong, Lizhe Chen, Lingrui Mei, Zehao Li, Yiwei Wang, Yujun Cai, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces PromptCD, a test-time behavior control method using polarity-prompt contrastive decoding. Constructs paired positive/negative prompts to steer LLM outputs toward desired behaviors without retraining.

entry.title: NoRD: A Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model that Drives without Reasoning

author.name: Ishaan Rawal, Shubh Gupta, Yihan Hu, Wei Zhan

entry.summary: Introduces NoRD, a VLA model for autonomous driving that achieves competitive performance with <60% of data and no reasoning annotations by using modified GRPO with a tailored reward function.

entry.title: Controllable Exploration in Hybrid-Policy RLVR for Multi-Modal Reasoning

author.name: Zhuoxu Huang, Mengxi Jia, Hao Sun, Xuelong Li, Jungong Han

entry.summary: Proposes CalibRL, a hybrid-policy RLVR framework for multimodal reasoning that maintains controllable exploration with expert guidance through distribution-aware advantage weighting.

entry.title: Model Merging in the Essential Subspace

author.name: Longhua Li, Lei Qi, Qi Tian, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes ESM (Essential Subspace Merging) for model merging using PCA on feature shifts to identify essential subspaces, then projecting updates for low-rank decomposition before merging.

entry.title: Protein Language Models Diverge from Natural Language: Comparative Analysis and Improved Inference

author.name: Anna Hart, Chi Han, Jeonghwan Kim, Huimin Zhao, Heng Ji

entry.summary: Compares how transformer architectures operate differently in protein vs. natural language domains, finding key differences in information distribution across attention heads. Adapts early-exit strategies to improve PLM inference efficiency.

entry.title: Wireless Federated Multi-Task LLM Fine-Tuning via Sparse-and-Orthogonal LoRA

author.name: Nuocheng Yang, Sihua Wang, Ouwen Huan, Mingzhe Chen, Tony Q. S. Quek, Changchuan Yin

entry.summary: Proposes sparse-and-orthogonal LoRA for wireless federated multi-task LLM fine-tuning, addressing catastrophic forgetting, communication inefficiency, and task interference through orthogonality constraints.

entry.title: Position-Aware Sequential Attention for Accurate Next Item Recommendations

author.name: Timur Nabiev, Evgeny Frolov

entry.summary: Introduces a kernelized self-attention mechanism for sequential recommendation where a learnable positional kernel operates directly within the attention computation, providing stronger position-awareness than additive embeddings.

entry.title: Localized Dynamics-Aware Domain Adaption for Off-Dynamics Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhangjie Xia, Yu Yang, Pan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes LoDADA for off-dynamics offline RL that exploits localized dynamics mismatch by clustering transitions and estimating cluster-level discrepancy for selective source data reuse.

entry.title: Is the Trigger Essential? A Feature-Based Triggerless Backdoor Attack in Vertical Federated Learning

author.name: Yige Liu, Yiwei Lou, Che Wang, Yongzhi Cao, Hanpin Wang

entry.summary: Reveals a new triggerless backdoor attack pathway in vertical federated learning where attacks are feature-based rather than requiring explicit triggers during inference.

entry.title: Deep unfolding of MCMC kernels: scalable, modular & explainable GANs for high-dimensional posterior sampling

author.name: Jonathan Spence, Tob\'ias I. Liaudat, Konstantinos Zygalakis, Marcelo Pereyra

entry.summary: Introduces deep unfolding of Langevin MCMC into modular GAN architectures for high-dimensional posterior sampling, yielding scalable, explainable generative models that maintain Bayesian modularity.

entry.title: Sequential Counterfactual Inference for Temporal Clinical Data: Addressing the Time Traveler Dilemma

author.name: Jingya Cheng, Alaleh Azhir, Jiazi Tian, Hossein Estiri

entry.summary: Introduces a Sequential Counterfactual Framework for longitudinal clinical data that respects temporal dependencies, distinguishing immutable from controllable features. Applied to Long COVID heart failure analysis.

entry.title: Prior-Agnostic Incentive-Compatible Exploration

author.name: Ramya Ramalingam, Osbert Bastani, Aaron Roth

entry.summary: Studies prior-agnostic incentive-compatible exploration in bandits, showing that swap regret bounds suffice for agents to follow recommendations without requiring a shared common prior.

entry.title: Empirically Calibrated Conditional Independence Tests

author.name: Milleno Pan, Antoine de Mathelin, Wesley Tansey

entry.summary: Proposes ECCIT, a method to empirically calibrate conditional independence tests by measuring and correcting for miscalibration. Addresses failure modes in both small-sample and misspecified-model settings for causal discovery.

entry.title: Blackbird Language Matrices: A Framework to Investigate the Linguistic Competence of Language Models

author.name: Paola Merlo, Chunyang Jiang, Giuseppe Samo, Vivi Nastase

entry.summary: Introduces Blackbird Language Matrices (BLM), a novel evaluation task inspired by intelligence tests, designed to probe LLMs' linguistic competence including chunking and systematicity through structured multiple-choice problems.

entry.title: Prompt-Level Distillation: A Non-Parametric Alternative to Model Fine-Tuning for Efficient Reasoning

author.name: Sanket Badhe, Deep Shah

entry.summary: Introduces Prompt-Level Distillation (PLD), which extracts reasoning patterns from a teacher model and converts them into structured system prompt instructions for a student model. Achieves large F1 improvements on Gemma-3 4B without fine-tuning.

entry.title: MedCLIPSeg: Probabilistic Vision-Language Adaptation for Data-Efficient and Generalizable Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Taha Koleilat, Hojat Asgariandehkordi, Omid Nejati Manzari, Berardino Barile, Yiming Xiao, Hassan Rivaz

entry.summary: Presents MedCLIPSeg, a framework adapting CLIP for medical image segmentation with probabilistic cross-modal attention and uncertainty-aware predictions. Enables data-efficient, text-guided segmentation with explicit uncertainty modeling.

entry.title: gQIR: Generative Quanta Image Reconstruction

author.name: Aryan Garg, Sizhuo Ma, Mohit Gupta

entry.summary: Adapts large text-to-image diffusion models for quanta burst imaging (single-photon cameras), leveraging generative priors for reconstruction from extremely sparse, binary photon detections.

entry.title: GA-Drive: Geometry-Appearance Decoupled Modeling for Free-viewpoint Driving Scene Generatio

author.name: Hao Zhang, Lue Fan, Qitai Wang, Wenbo Li, Zehuan Wu, Lewei Lu, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: GA-Drive presents a driving simulation framework that decouples geometry and appearance for free-viewpoint novel view synthesis, using geometry-based pseudo-views refined by a video diffusion model. Supports appearance editing for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: EW-DETR: Evolving World Object Detection via Incremental Low-Rank DEtection TRansformer

author.name: Munish Monga, Vishal Chudasama, Pankaj Wasnik, C. V. Jawahar

entry.summary: EW-DETR introduces Evolving World Object Detection, coupling incremental learning, domain adaptation, and unknown detection under exemplar-free constraints. Uses LoRA adapters and entropy-aware unknown mixing for DETR-based detectors.

entry.title: Event-Aided Sharp Radiance Field Reconstruction for Fast-Flying Drones

author.name: Rong Zou, Marco Cannici, Davide Scaramuzza

entry.summary: Presents a framework combining event cameras with motion-blurred frames for sharp radiance field reconstruction from fast-flying drone footage, jointly refining event-based visual-inertial odometry with NeRF optimization.

entry.title: Human Video Generation from a Single Image with 3D Pose and View Control

author.name: Tiantian Wang, Chun-Han Yao, Tao Hu, Mallikarjun Byrasandra Ramalinga Reddy, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Varun Jampani

entry.summary: HVG generates multi-view, spatiotemporally coherent human videos from a single image with 3D pose and view control using articulated pose modulation in a latent video diffusion model.

entry.title: Generalizing from References using a Multi-Task Reference and Goal-Driven RL Framework

author.name: Jiashun Wang, M. Eva Mungai, He Li, Jean Pierre Sleiman, Jessica Hodgins, Farbod Farshidian

entry.summary: Introduces a unified multi-task RL framework for humanoid locomotion that uses reference motion as a behavioral prior rather than deployment-time constraint, training a single policy on reference-guided and task-driven objectives.

entry.title: GeCo-SRT: Geometry-aware Continual Adaptation for Robotic Cross-Task Sim-to-Real Transfer

author.name: Wenbo Yu, Wenke Xia, Weitao Zhang, Di Hu

entry.summary: GeCo-SRT proposes geometry-aware continual adaptation for cross-task sim-to-real transfer, accumulating transferable knowledge from local geometric features across iterative transfers rather than treating each transfer in isolation.

entry.title: Skullptor: High Fidelity 3D Head Reconstruction in Seconds with Multi-View Normal Prediction

author.name: No\'e Artru, Rukhshanda Hussain, Emeline Got, Alexandre Messier, David B. Lindell, Abdallah Dib

entry.summary: Skullptor achieves high-fidelity 3D head reconstruction in seconds using multi-view normal prediction, combining foundation model efficiency with optimization-based detail through a hybrid approach.

entry.title: Grasp to Act: Dexterous Grasping for Tool Use in Dynamic Settings

author.name: Harsh Gupta, Mohammad Amin Mirzaee, Wenzhen Yuan

entry.summary: Grasp-to-Act combines physics-based grasp optimization with RL-based grasp adaptation for maintaining stable tool grasps during dynamic manipulation tasks involving impacts, torques, and continuous resistance.

entry.title: DMCD: Semantic-Statistical Framework for Causal Discovery

author.name: Samarth KaPatel, Sofia Nikiforova, Giacinto Paolo Saggese, Paul Smith

entry.summary: Proposes DMCD, a two-phase causal discovery framework that uses an LLM to draft an initial causal DAG from variable metadata, then refines it with statistical conditional independence testing. Evaluated on three real-world benchmarks.

entry.title: How Foundational Skills Influence VLM-based Embodied Agents:A Native Perspective

author.name: Bo Peng, Pi Bu, Keyu Pan, Xinrun Xu, Yinxiu Zhao, Miao Chen, Yang Du, Lin Li, Jun Song, Tong Xu

entry.summary: Presents NativeEmbodied, a benchmark for VLM-driven embodied agents using a unified native low-level action space, evaluating both foundational skills and high-level task performance in complex simulated scenarios.

entry.title: Diagnosing Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Structured Relevance Graphs

author.name: Dhita Putri Pratama, Soyeon Caren Han, Yihao Ding

entry.summary: Introduces Vision-Language Causal Graphs (VLCGs) and ViLCaR benchmark to diagnose whether VLMs fail at causal reasoning due to limited reasoning capability vs misidentifying causally relevant information.

entry.title: HELP: HyperNode Expansion and Logical Path-Guided Evidence Localization for Accurate and Efficient GraphRAG

author.name: Yuqi Huang, Ning Liao, Kai Yang, Anning Hu, Shengchao Hu, Xiaoxing Wang, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Proposes HELP, a GraphRAG framework using HyperNode expansion and logical path-guided evidence localization for multi-hop reasoning, balancing accuracy with efficiency through hierarchical strategies.

entry.title: Global Prior Meets Local Consistency: Dual-Memory Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model for Efficient Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Zaijing Li, Bing Hu, Rui Shao, Gongwei Chen, Dongmei Jiang, Pengwei Xie, Jianye Hao, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-memory augmented VLA model for robotic manipulation that addresses low inference efficiency and poor robustness through informed priors and history-aware temporal consistency.

entry.title: Golden Layers and Where to Find Them: Improved Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models Via Layer Gradient Analysis

author.name: Shrestha Datta, Hongfu Liu, Anshuman Chhabra

entry.summary: Proposes finding 'golden layers' for knowledge editing in LLMs via gradient analysis. Shows fixed golden layers achieve near-optimal performance compared to sample-wise optimal layers.

entry.title: Imputation of Unknown Missingness in Sparse Electronic Health Records

author.name: Jun Han, Josue Nassar, Sanjit Singh Batra, Aldo Cordova-Palomera, Vijay Nori, Robert E. Tillman

entry.summary: Addresses the challenge of imputing missing data in electronic health records when the missingness mechanism itself is unknown—distinguishing between 'condition not present' vs 'diagnosis made but not shared.' Proposes methods for these 'unknown unknowns.'

entry.title: How Do Inpainting Artifacts Propagate to Language?

author.name: Pratham Yashwante, Davit Abrahamyan, Shresth Grover, Sukruth Rao

entry.summary: Studies how visual artifacts from diffusion-based inpainting propagate to and affect language generation in vision-language models, revealing systematic and predictable error patterns in downstream captioning.

entry.title: Dataset Color Quantization: A Training-Oriented Framework for Dataset-Level Compression

author.name: Chenyue Yu, Lingao Xiao, Jinhong Deng, Ivor W. Tsang, Yang He

entry.summary: Proposes Dataset Color Quantization (DCQ), a framework for compressing visual datasets by reducing color-space redundancy while preserving training-relevant information through consistent palette representations.

entry.title: OrthoDiffusion: A Generalizable Multi-Task Diffusion Foundation Model for Musculoskeletal MRI Interpretation

author.name: Tian Lan, Lei Xu, Zimu Yuan, Shanggui Liu, Jiajun Liu, Jiaxin Liu, Weilai Xiang, Hongyu Yang, Dong Jiang, Jianxin Yin, Dingyu Wang

entry.summary: Develops OrthoDiffusion, a unified diffusion-based foundation model for multi-task musculoskeletal MRI interpretation using orientation-specific 3D diffusion models pre-trained on 15,948 unlabeled scans.

entry.title: Airavat: An Agentic Framework for Internet Measurement

author.name: Alagappan Ramanathan, Eunju Kang, Dongsu Han, Sangeetha Abdu Jyothi

entry.summary: Presents Airavat, the first agentic framework for Internet measurement that automates workflow generation with systematic verification against methodological standards, coordinating multiple specialized agents.

entry.title: Probing Graph Neural Network Activation Patterns Through Graph Topology

author.name: Floriano Tori, Lorenzo Bini, Marco Sorbi, St\'ephane Marchand-Maillet, Vincent Ginis

entry.summary: Probes Graph Neural Network activation patterns through graph topology, finding that massive activations (extreme edge activation values) do not concentrate on curvature extremes despite theoretical expectations.

entry.title: Learning to Solve Complex Problems via Dataset Decomposition

author.name: Wanru Zhao, Lucas Caccia, Zhengyan Shi, Minseon Kim, Weijia Xu, Alessandro Sordoni

entry.summary: Proposes a reverse curriculum learning approach where a teacher model recursively decomposes complex datasets into simpler components for progressive student training. Uses a novel scoring system for data difficulty based on structural complexity and conceptual depth.

entry.title: Rethink Efficiency Side of Neural Combinatorial Solver: An Offline and Self-Play Paradigm

author.name: Zhenxing Xu, Zeyuan Ma, Weidong Bao, Hui Yan, Yan Zheng, Ji Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ECO, an efficient offline self-play paradigm for neural combinatorial optimization using supervised warm-up, iterative DPO, and a Mamba-based architecture for TSP and CVRP.

entry.title: SOM-VQ: Topology-Aware Tokenization for Interactive Generative Models

author.name: Alessandro Londei, Denise Lanzieri, Matteo Benati

entry.summary: Introduces SOM-VQ, a tokenization method combining vector quantization with Self-Organizing Maps to create discrete codebooks with explicit low-dimensional topology, enabling interpretable human control of generative models.

entry.title: Regressor-guided Diffusion Model for De Novo Peptide Sequencing with Explicit Mass Control

author.name: Shaorong Chen, Jingbo Zhou, Jun Xia

entry.summary: Introduces DiffuNovo, a regressor-guided diffusion model for de novo peptide sequencing that explicitly enforces mass consistency between predicted peptides and measured precursor mass.

entry.title: Gap-Dependent Bounds for Nearly Minimax Optimal Reinforcement Learning with Linear Function Approximation

author.name: Haochen Zhang, Zhong Zheng, Lingzhou Xue

entry.summary: Provides the first gap-dependent regret bound for the nearly minimax-optimal LSVI-UCB++ algorithm in RL with linear function approximation, improving dependencies on dimension and horizon.

entry.title: On the Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Descent with Perturbed Forward-Backward Passes

author.name: Boao Kong, Hengrui Zhang, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: Provides the first comprehensive theoretical analysis of SGD with perturbations in both forward and backward passes for composite optimization with sequential operators. Shows how perturbations compound geometrically and derives convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Adaptive Text Anonymization: Learning Privacy-Utility Trade-offs via Prompt Optimization

author.name: Gabriel Loiseau, Damien Sileo, Damien Riquet, Maxime Meyer, Marc Tommasi

entry.summary: Introduces adaptive text anonymization as a new task formulation where anonymization strategies are automatically adapted to specific privacy-utility requirements via prompt optimization for language models.

entry.title: Evaluating Proactive Risk Awareness of Large Language Models

author.name: Xuan Luo, Yubin Chen, Zhiyu Hou, Linpu Yu, Geng Tu, Jing Li, Ruifeng Xu

entry.summary: Introduces a proactive risk awareness evaluation framework for LLMs, measuring whether they can anticipate unintended ecological harms from ordinary queries. Constructs the Butterfly dataset with 1,094 queries testing latent ecological impact awareness.

entry.title: SpecMind: Cognitively Inspired, Interactive Multi-Turn Framework for Postcondition Inference

author.name: Cuong Chi Le, Minh V. T Pham, Tung Vu Duy, Cuong Duc Van, Huy N. Phan, Hoang N. Phan, Tien N. Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces SpecMind, a multi-turn framework for LLM-based postcondition generation that uses iterative refinement with correctness feedback, treating LLMs as interactive reasoners rather than one-shot generators.

entry.title: N4MC: Neural 4D Mesh Compression

author.name: Guodong Chen, Huanshuo Dong, Mallesham Dasari

entry.summary: Presents N4MC, the first neural 4D mesh compression framework that exploits temporal redundancy in time-varying mesh sequences, inspired by inter-frame video compression. Uses auto-decoder and transformer-based interpolation.

entry.title: SceMoS: Scene-Aware 3D Human Motion Synthesis by Planning with Geometry-Grounded Tokens

author.name: Anindita Ghosh, Vladislav Golyanik, Taku Komura, Philipp Slusallek, Christian Theobalt, Rishabh Dabral

entry.summary: Proposes SceMoS for text-driven 3D human motion synthesis in scenes using lightweight 2D scene representations instead of full 3D supervision. Disentangles global planning from local execution using geometry-grounded tokens.

entry.title: VAGNet: Grounding 3D Affordance from Human-Object Interactions in Videos

author.name: Aihua Mao, Kaihang Huang, Yong-Jin Liu, Chee Seng Chan, Ying He

entry.summary: Introduces VAGNet for video-guided 3D affordance grounding, leveraging dynamic human-object interaction sequences from video to provide functional supervision for identifying interaction regions on 3D objects.

entry.title: Object-Scene-Camera Decomposition and Recomposition for Data-Efficient Monocular 3D Object Detection

author.name: Zhaonian Kuang, Rui Ding, Meng Yang, Xinhu Zheng, Gang Hua

entry.summary: Proposes decomposing training data into independent object, scene, and camera pose components for monocular 3D object detection, then recomposing them to create more diverse training samples. This addresses the entanglement bias in real captured data that limits model generalization.

entry.title: NGL-Prompter: Training-Free Sewing Pattern Estimation from a Single Image

author.name: Anna Badalyan, Pratheba Selvaraju, Giorgio Becherini, Omid Taheri, Victoria Fernandez Abrevaya, Michael Black

entry.summary: NGL-Prompter estimates sewing patterns from single images without training, by using VLMs to describe garments in natural language and then mapping those descriptions to parametric garment codes. Bridges the gap between VLMs' language capabilities and parametric regression limitations.

entry.title: DA-Cal: Towards Cross-Domain Calibration in Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Wangkai Li, Rui Sun, Zhaoyang Li, Yujia Chen, Tianzhu Zhang

entry.summary: DA-Cal addresses network calibration in unsupervised domain adaptation for semantic segmentation, showing that poor calibration causes soft pseudo-labels to underperform hard ones. Proposes a dedicated cross-domain calibration framework.

entry.title: UFO: Unifying Feed-Forward and Optimization-based Methods for Large Driving Scene Modeling

author.name: Kaiyuan Tan, Yingying Shen, Mingfei Tu, Haohui Zhu, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Haiyang Sun

entry.summary: UFO combines optimization-based and feed-forward methods for long-range 4D driving scene reconstruction through a recurrent paradigm with visibility-based filtering for efficient processing of extended sequences.

entry.title: BrepGaussian: CAD reconstruction from Multi-View Images with Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Jiaxing Yu, Dongyang Ren, Hangyu Xu, Zhouyuxiao Yang, Yuanqi Li, Jie Guo, Zhengkang Zhou, Yanwen Guo

entry.summary: BrepGaussian recovers boundary representation (B-rep) CAD models from multi-view images using Gaussian Splatting with learnable features and a two-stage learning strategy that decouples geometry reconstruction from feature learning.

entry.title: UDVideoQA: A Traffic Video Question Answering Dataset for Multi-Object Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in Urban Dynamics

author.name: Joseph Raj Vishal, Nagasiri Poluri, Katha Naik, Rutuja Patil, Kashyap Hegde Kota, Krishna Vinod, Prithvi Jai Ramesh, Mohammad Farhadi, Yezhou Yang, Bharatesh Chakravarthi

entry.summary: UDVideoQA is a traffic video QA benchmark with 28K question-answer pairs from 16 hours of urban footage, featuring hierarchical reasoning taxonomy for multi-object spatio-temporal understanding in dynamic scenes.

entry.title: BFA++: Hierarchical Best-Feature-Aware Token Prune for Multi-View Vision Language Action Model

author.name: Haosheng Li, Weixin Mao, Zihan Lan, Hongwei Xiong, Hongan Wang, Chenyang Si, Ziwei Liu, Xiaoming Deng, Hua Chen

entry.summary: BFA++ proposes hierarchical token pruning specifically for multi-view VLA models, accounting for inter-view relationships and task-specific dynamics that generic VLM pruning methods miss.

entry.title: KairosVL: Orchestrating Time Series and Semantics for Unified Reasoning

author.name: Haotian Si, Changhua Pei, Xiao He, Zeyan Li, Zhe Xie, Zexin Wang, Jiyao Hu, Zhaoyang Yu, Tieying Zhang, Dan Pei, Jianhui Li, Gaogang Xie

entry.summary: Introduces KairosVL for semantic-conditional time series reasoning, combining numerical modeling with contextual understanding. Uses a two-round RL framework to build perception of temporal primitives and semantic-conditioned reasoning.

entry.title: GENSR: Symbolic Regression Based in Equation Generative Space

author.name: Qian Li, Yuxiao Hu, Juncheng Liu, Yuntian Chen

entry.summary: Introduces GenSR, a symbolic regression framework using a dual-branch CVAE to create a generative latent space with symbolic continuity and numerical smoothness, enabling better equation discovery.

entry.title: Understanding the Role of Rehearsal Scale in Continual Learning under Varying Model Capacities

author.name: JinLi He, Liang Bai, Xian Yang

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of how rehearsal scale influences adaptability, memorability, and generalization in continual learning, revealing counterintuitive findings including that rehearsal can impair model performance.

entry.title: DRESS: A Continuous Framework for Structural Graph Refinement

author.name: Eduar Castrillo Velilla

entry.summary: Proposes DRESS, a continuous dynamical system framework for structural graph refinement that generalizes beyond 1-WL expressiveness. Shows the framework can distinguish graphs that 1-WL cannot and supports arbitrary structural motifs.

entry.title: Path-Decoupled Hyperbolic Flow Matching for Few-Shot Adaptation

author.name: Lin Li, Ziqi Jiang, Gefan Ye, Zhenqi He, Jiahui Li, Jun Xiao, Kwang-Ting Cheng, Long Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Hyperbolic Flow Matching (HFM) for few-shot adaptation, leveraging Lorentz manifold geometry for trajectory decoupling in visual-semantic alignment. Addresses path entanglement in Euclidean flow matching.

entry.title: PropFly: Learning to Propagate via On-the-Fly Supervision from Pre-trained Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Wonyong Seo, Jaeho Moon, Jaehyup Lee, Soo Ye Kim, Munchurl Kim

entry.summary: Proposes PropFly, a training pipeline for propagation-based video editing using on-the-fly supervision from pre-trained video diffusion models, eliminating the need for paired video editing datasets.

entry.title: MatchED: Crisp Edge Detection Using End-to-End, Matching-based Supervision

author.name: Bedrettin Cetinkaya, Sinan Kalkan, Emre Akbas

entry.summary: MatchED proposes a lightweight matching-based supervision module for end-to-end crisp edge detection, eliminating the need for non-differentiable post-processing like NMS or thinning. Only adds ~21K parameters and is plug-and-play for any edge detector.

entry.title: SIMSPINE: A Biomechanics-Aware Simulation Framework for 3D Spine Motion Annotation and Benchmarking

author.name: Muhammad Saif Ullah Khan, Didier Stricker

entry.summary: SIMSPINE presents a biomechanics-aware simulation framework that augments human pose datasets with anatomically consistent 3D spinal keypoints from musculoskeletal modeling. Creates the first open dataset with 2.14M frames of vertebra-level 3D spinal annotations.

entry.title: Hybrid Fusion: One-Minute Efficient Training for Zero-Shot Cross-Domain Image Fusion

author.name: Ran Zhang, Xuanhua He, Liu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid image fusion framework combining a learnable U-Net guidance map with a fixed Laplacian pyramid fusion kernel, enabling one-minute training for zero-shot cross-domain image fusion by decoupling policy learning from pixel synthesis.

entry.title: Mask-HybridGNet: Graph-based segmentation with emergent anatomical correspondence from pixel-level supervision

author.name: Nicol\'as Gaggion, Maria J. Ledesma-Carbayo, Stergios Christodoulidis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Enzo Ferrante

entry.summary: Mask-HybridGNet trains graph-based medical image segmentation using standard pixel masks instead of manual landmark annotations, achieving anatomical correspondence through Chamfer distance supervision and edge regularization.

entry.title: Strategy-Supervised Autonomous Laparoscopic Camera Control via Event-Driven Graph Mining

author.name: Keyu Zhou, Peisen Xu, Yahao Wu, Jiming Chen, Gaofeng Li, Shunlei Li

entry.summary: Proposes a strategy-grounded framework for autonomous laparoscopic camera control that couples VLM-based strategy inference with closed-loop control, using event graphs mined from surgical videos for structured supervision.

entry.title: Matching Multiple Experts: On the Exploitability of Multi-Agent Imitation Learning

author.name: Antoine Bergerault, Volkan Cevher, Negar Mehr

entry.summary: Demonstrates impossibility and hardness results for learning low-exploitable policies in multi-agent imitation learning for general n-player Markov Games, showing exact measure matching can fail.

entry.title: CAD-Prompted SAM3: Geometry-Conditioned Instance Segmentation for Industrial Objects

author.name: Zhenran Tang, Rohan Nagabhirava, Changliu Liu

entry.summary: Proposes CAD-prompted SAM3, a segmentation framework using CAD models as prompts instead of text or image exemplars for industrial object segmentation, addressing limitations of appearance-based prompting in manufacturing.

entry.title: Training-Free Multi-Concept Image Editing

author.name: Niki Foteinopoulou, Ignas Budvytis, Stephan Liwicki

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework for multi-concept image editing that combines optimized DDS with LoRA-driven concept composition in diffusion models. Enables controlling multiple visual concepts that cannot be expressed through text alone.

entry.title: Not Just What's There: Enabling CLIP to Comprehend Negated Visual Descriptions Without Fine-tuning

author.name: Junhao Xiao, Zhiyu Wu, Hao Lin, Yi Chen, Yahui Liu, Xiaoran Zhao, Zixu Wang, Zejiang He

entry.summary: CLIPGlasses enhances CLIP's negation understanding without fine-tuning through a plug-and-play dual-stage framework that disentangles negated semantics and predicts context-aware repulsion strength for modified similarity computation.

entry.title: Diffusion Modulation via Environment Mechanism Modeling for Planning

author.name: Hanping Zhang, Yuhong Guo

entry.summary: Proposes DMEMM, a diffusion-based planning method for offline RL that modulates diffusion training by incorporating environment transition dynamics and reward mechanisms to improve trajectory coherence.

entry.title: From Logs to Language: Learning Optimal Verbalization for LLM-Based Recommendation in Production

author.name: Yucheng Shi, Ying Li, Yu Wang, Yesu Feng, Arjun Rao, Rein Houthooft, Shradha Sehgal, Jin Wang, Hao Zhen, Ninghao Liu, Linas Baltrunas

entry.summary: Proposes a data-centric framework using RL to learn optimal verbalization of user interaction logs for LLM-based recommendation systems. The verbalization agent transforms raw histories into optimized textual contexts.

entry.title: Pipeline for Verifying LLM-Generated Mathematical Solutions

author.name: Varvara Sazonova, Dmitri Shmelkin, Stanislav Kikot, Vasily Motolygin

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline for verifying LLM-generated mathematical solutions using 3 AI agents, combining automatic and interactive verification with proof assistants as an alternative to answer-only checking.

entry.title: Multimodal Crystal Flow: Any-to-Any Modality Generation for Unified Crystal Modeling

author.name: Kiyoung Seong, Sungsoo Ahn, Sehui Han, Changyoung Park

entry.summary: Proposes MCFlow, a unified multimodal flow model for crystal generation that handles multiple tasks (crystal structure prediction, de novo generation) via independent time variables in a standard transformer.

entry.title: CodeHacker: Automated Test Case Generation for Detecting Vulnerabilities in Competitive Programming Solutions

author.name: Jingwei Shi, Xinxiang Yin, Jing Huang, Jinman Zhao, Shengyu Tao

entry.summary: Proposes CodeHacker, an automated agent for generating adversarial test cases to expose vulnerabilities in code submissions, using stress testing, anti-hash attacks, and logic-specific targeting strategies.

entry.title: Right to History: A Sovereignty Kernel for Verifiable AI Agent Execution

author.name: Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes 'Right to History' - the principle that individuals deserve verifiable records of AI agent actions on their hardware. Formalizes via five system invariants inspired by Floridi's informational rights framework.

entry.title: Case-Aware LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation for Enterprise-Scale RAG Systems

author.name: Mukul Chhabra, Luigi Medrano, Arush Verma

entry.summary: Presents a case-aware LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework for enterprise multi-turn RAG systems with eight operationally grounded metrics that separate retrieval quality from generation quality across turns.

entry.title: RMIT-ADM+S at the MMU-RAG NeurIPS 2025 Competition

author.name: Kun Ran, Marwah Alaofi, Danula Hettiachchi, Chenglong Ma, Khoi Nguyen Dinh Anh, Khoi Vo Nguyen, Sachin Pathiyan Cherumanal, Lida Rashidi, Falk Scholer, Damiano Spina, Shuoqi Sun, Oleg Zendel

entry.summary: Presents R2RAG, an award-winning RAG system from RMIT for the NeurIPS 2025 MMU-RAG competition that dynamically adapts retrieval strategy based on query complexity, operating on a single consumer GPU.

entry.title: Toward an Agentic Infused Software Ecosystem

author.name: Mark Marron

entry.summary: Outlines a vision for an Agentic Infused Software Ecosystem (AISE) built on three pillars: AI agents, programming languages/APIs as communication substrate, and runtime environments.

entry.title: Quantitative Approximation Rates for Group Equivariant Learning

author.name: Jonathan W. Siegel, Snir Hordan, Hannah Lawrence, Ali Syed, Nadav Dym

entry.summary: Provides quantitative approximation rates for group equivariant neural networks on Hölder functions, bridging the gap between universal approximation properties and concrete rate guarantees for equivariant models.

entry.title: Sample-efficient evidence estimation of score based priors for model selection

author.name: Frederic Wang, Katherine L. Bouman

entry.summary: Proposes a sample-efficient method for estimating model evidence with diffusion priors for Bayesian model selection in imaging inverse problems, avoiding the need for many evaluations of the prior density.

entry.title: Fuz-RL: A Fuzzy-Guided Robust Framework for Safe Reinforcement Learning under Uncertainty

author.name: Xu Wan, Chao Yang, Cheng Yang, Jie Song, Mingyang Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Fuz-RL, a fuzzy measure-guided framework for safe reinforcement learning that uses Choquet integrals for robust value estimation, proving equivalence to distributionally robust safe RL.

entry.title: Knowing the Unknown: Interpretable Open-World Object Detection via Concept Decomposition Model

author.name: Xueqiang Lv, Shizhou Zhang, Yinghui Xing, Di Xu, Peng Wang, Yanning Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces IPOW, an interpretable open-world object detection framework using concept decomposition to explicitly separate discriminative, shared, and background features. Aims to address the known-unknown confusion problem in open-world detection.

entry.title: Generative Pseudo-Labeling for Pre-Ranking with LLMs

author.name: Junyu Bi, Xinting Niu, Daixuan Cheng, Kun Yuan, Tao Wang, Binbin Cao, Jian Wu, Yuning Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs for generative pseudo-labeling in recommendation system pre-ranking to address train-serving discrepancy and sample selection bias, particularly for unexposed and long-tail content.

entry.title: An Expert Schema for Evaluating Large Language Model Errors in Scholarly Question-Answering Systems

author.name: Anna Martin-Boyle, William Humphreys, Martha Brown, Cara Leckey, Harmanpreet Kaur

entry.summary: Develops a validated error schema for evaluating LLM errors in scholarly QA systems, identifying 20 error patterns across seven categories through collaboration with domain experts and contextual inquiries.

entry.title: CLIPoint3D: Language-Grounded Few-Shot Unsupervised 3D Point Cloud Domain Adaptation

author.name: Mainak Singha, Sarthak Mehrotra, Paolo Casari, Subhasis Chaudhuri, Elisa Ricci, Biplab Banerjee

entry.summary: Introduces CLIPoint3D, the first framework for few-shot unsupervised 3D point cloud domain adaptation built on CLIP, using depth map projections and knowledge-driven prompt tuning to handle synthetic-to-real domain shifts.

entry.title: Efficient and Explainable End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Masked Vision-Language-Action Diffusion

author.name: Jiaru Zhang, Manav Gagvani, Can Cui, Juntong Peng, Ruqi Zhang, Ziran Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MVLAD-AD, combining vision-language understanding with diffusion-based planning for autonomous driving. Uses masked tokens to bridge efficient planning with semantic explainability.

entry.title: AnimeAgent: Is the Multi-Agent via Image-to-Video models a Good Disney Storytelling Artist?

author.name: Hailong Yan, Shice Liu, Tao Wang, Xiangtao Zhang, Yijie Zhong, Jinwei Chen, Le Zhang, Bo Li

entry.summary: AnimeAgent is the first Image-to-Video multi-agent framework for custom storyboard generation, inspired by Disney's animation workflow. It addresses content consistency, dynamic expressiveness, and iterative correction limitations of static diffusion-based approaches.

entry.title: Real-time Motion Segmentation with Event-based Normal Flow

author.name: Sheng Zhong, Zhongyang Ren, Xiya Zhu, Dehao Yuan, Cornelia Fermuller, Yi Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a real-time motion segmentation method using event-based cameras with normal flow as an intermediate representation, compressing motion information from event clusters for efficient processing in dynamic scenes.

entry.title: Le-DETR: Revisiting Real-Time Detection Transformer with Efficient Encoder Design

author.name: Jiannan Huang, Aditya Kane, Fengzhe Zhou, Yunchao Wei, Humphrey Shi

entry.summary: Le-DETR revisits real-time DETR design with EfficientNAT backbone combining efficient convolution and local attention, achieving high performance with low pre-training cost, making exploration of novel backbones more accessible.

entry.title: OCR-Agent: Agentic OCR with Capability and Memory Reflection

author.name: Shimin Wen, Zeyu Zhang, Xingdou Bian, Hongjie Zhu, Lulu He, Layi Shama, Daji Ergu, Ying Cai

entry.summary: OCR-Agent proposes an iterative self-correction framework for VLMs with Capability Reflection (error diagnosis and correction planning) and Memory Reflection (leveraging past correction experience) for improved OCR performance.

entry.title: FACTO: Function-space Adaptive Constrained Trajectory Optimization for Robotic Manipulators

author.name: Yichang Feng, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: FACTO introduces function-space trajectory optimization for robotic manipulators, parameterizing trajectories as linear combinations of orthogonal basis functions and optimizing in coefficient space with adaptive constrained updates.

entry.title: Bioanchors 2: Electric Bacilli

author.name: TsviBT

entry.summary: Critiques arguments for fast AGI timelines, arguing that while progress indicators (scaling, investment, researcher pivoting) are valid, they don't provide enough information about absolute proximity to AGI without knowing 'how much of what you need do you have.'

entry.title: Online Algorithms with Unreliable Guidance

author.name: Julien Dallot, Yuval Emek, Yuval Gil, Maciej Pacut, Stefan Schmid

entry.summary: Introduces Online Algorithms with Unreliable Guidance (OAG), a formal model for ML-augmented online decision making where guidance is adversarially corrupted with probability β. Provides consistency and robustness analysis.

entry.title: High-Dimensional Robust Mean Estimation with Untrusted Batches

author.name: Maryam Aliakbarpour, Vladimir Braverman, Yuhan Liu, Junze Yin

entry.summary: Studies high-dimensional robust mean estimation with untrusted batches under a double corruption model combining adversarial users and distributional deviation, providing new error bounds.

entry.title: On the Generalization Behavior of Deep Residual Networks From a Dynamical System Perspective

author.name: Jinshu Huang, Mingfei Sun, Chunlin Wu

entry.summary: Establishes generalization error bounds for both discrete and continuous-time ResNets using Rademacher complexity and dynamical systems flow maps, showing depth-uniform bounds of order O(1/√S).

entry.title: DANCE: Doubly Adaptive Neighborhood Conformal Estimation

author.name: Brandon R. Feng, Brian J. Reich, Daniel Beaglehole, Xihaier Luo, David Keetae Park, Shinjae Yoo, Zhechao Huang, Xueyu Mao, Olcay Boz, Jungeum Kim

entry.summary: Proposes DANCE, a conformal prediction method for classification that uses nearest-neighbor approaches in embedding space rather than logit scores. Combines two novel nonconformity scores for better uncertainty quantification with pre-trained models.

entry.title: Robust Spiking Neural Networks Against Adversarial Attacks

author.name: Shuai Wang, Malu Zhang, Yulin Jiang, Dehao Zhang, Ammar Belatreche, Yu Liang, Yimeng Shan, Zijian Zhou, Yang Yang, Haizhou Li

entry.summary: Proposes Threshold Guarding Optimization (TGO) for improving adversarial robustness of spiking neural networks, theoretically identifying threshold-neighboring neurons as the key vulnerability factor.

entry.title: BoxSplitGen: A Generative Model for 3D Part Bounding Boxes in Varying Granularity

author.name: Juil Koo, Wei-Tung Lin, Chanho Park, Chanhyeok Park, Minhyuk Sung

entry.summary: BoxSplitGen generates 3D part bounding boxes at varying granularity through iterative splitting, enabling intuitive coarse-to-fine 3D shape generation. The framework supports interactive 3D creation by progressively refining abstract shapes into detailed structures.

entry.title: Federated Learning for Cross-Modality Medical Image Segmentation via Augmentation-Driven Generalization

author.name: Sachin Dudda Nagaraju, Ashkan Moradi, Bendik Skarre Abrahamsen, Mattijs Elschot

entry.summary: Addresses cross-modality domain shifts in federated learning for medical image segmentation, where each client holds only CT or MRI data. Uses augmentation-driven generalization without requiring paired multimodal data.

entry.title: MUSE: Harnessing Precise and Diverse Semantics for Few-Shot Whole Slide Image Classification

author.name: Jiahao Xu, Sheng Huang, Xin Zhang, Zhixiong Nan, Jiajun Dong, Nankun Mu

entry.summary: MUSE proposes stochastic multi-view semantic enhancement for few-shot whole slide image classification, refining class-level semantic priors into sample-wise adapted representations via retrieval-augmented generation.

entry.title: Dropping Anchor and Spherical Harmonics for Sparse-view Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Shuangkang Fang, I-Chao Shen, Xuanyang Zhang, Zesheng Wang, Yufeng Wang, Wenrui Ding, Gang Yu, Takeo Igarashi

entry.summary: DropAnSH-GS proposes anchor-based dropout for sparse-view Gaussian Splatting that removes spatial neighbor groups instead of individual Gaussians, and also addresses overfitting from high-degree spherical harmonics.

entry.title: OmniOCR: Generalist OCR for Ethnic Minority Languages

author.name: Bonan Liu, Zeyu Zhang, Bingbing Meng, Han Wang, Hanshuo Zhang, Chengping Wang, Daji Ergu, Ying Cai

entry.summary: OmniOCR presents a universal OCR framework for ethnic minority scripts using Dynamic LoRA to allocate model capacity across layers and scripts, with sparsity regularization for efficient adaptation while preserving knowledge.

entry.title: Vision-Based Reasoning with Topology-Encoded Graphs for Anatomical Path Disambiguation in Robot-Assisted Endovascular Navigation

author.name: Jiyuan Zhao, Zhengyu Shi, Wentong Tian, Tianliang Yao, Dong Liu, Tao Liu, Yizhe Wu, Peng Qi

entry.summary: SCAR-UNet-GAT is a two-stage framework for robotic path planning in coronary intervention, using attention-regularized U-Net for vessel segmentation and graph attention networks for topology-encoded path disambiguation.

entry.title: KCFRC: Kinematic Collision-Aware Foothold Reachability Criteria for Legged Locomotion

author.name: Lei Ye, Haibo Gao, Huaiguang Yang, Peng Xu, Haoyu Wang, Tie Liu, Junqi Shan, Zongquan Deng, Liang Ding

entry.summary: KCFRC introduces kinematic collision-aware foothold reachability analysis for legged robots, establishing sufficient conditions and an efficient algorithm for validating non-collision swing trajectories in real-time.

entry.title: GauS: Differentiable Scheduling Optimization via Gaussian Reparameterization

author.name: Yaohui Cai, Vesal Bakhtazad, Cunxi Yu, Zhiru Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GauS, a differentiable scheduling framework using Gaussian reparameterization that models operator scheduling as continuous variables, reducing parameter space and leveraging GPU parallelism.

entry.title: Exploring the Impact of Parameter Update Magnitude on Forgetting and Generalization of Continual Learning

author.name: JinLi He, Liang Bai, Xian Yang

entry.summary: Characterizes forgetting in continual learning from the parameter update magnitude perspective, deriving optimal update magnitudes that minimize forgetting and unifying frozen and initialized training paradigms.

entry.title: Leveraging Causal Reasoning Method for Explaining Medical Image Segmentation Models

author.name: Limai Jiang, Ruitao Xie, Bokai Yang, Huazhen Huang, Juan He, Yufu Huo, Zikai Wang, Yang Wei, Yunpeng Cai

entry.summary: Introduces a causal inference-based explanation method for medical image segmentation, using average treatment effect (ATE) backpropagation to determine influence of input regions and network components on segmentation outputs.

entry.title: Long-Term Multi-Session 3D Reconstruction Under Substantial Appearance Change

author.name: Beverley Gorry, Tobias Fischer, Michael Milford, Alejandro Fontan

entry.summary: Addresses long-term multi-session 3D reconstruction under substantial appearance change (e.g., coral reef monitoring) by enforcing cross-session correspondences within joint SfM rather than post-hoc alignment.

entry.title: CleanStyle: Plug-and-Play Style Conditioning Purification for Text-to-Image Stylization

author.name: Xiaoman Feng, Mingkun Lei, Yang Wang, Dingwen Fu, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: CleanStyle is a plug-and-play framework that removes content leakage from style embeddings in diffusion-based style transfer using SVD decomposition. It identifies that content leakage stems from tail components of style embeddings.

entry.title: Cycle-Consistent Tuning for Layered Image Decomposition

author.name: Zheng Gu, Min Lu, Zhida Sun, Dani Lischinski, Daniel Cohen-O, Hui Huang

entry.summary: Presents a cycle-consistent tuning framework for layered image decomposition using diffusion models, focusing on logo-object decomposition with jointly trained decomposition and composition models.

entry.title: Seeing Through Words: Controlling Visual Retrieval Quality with Language Models

author.name: Jianglin Lu, Simon Jenni, Kushal Kafle, Jing Shi, Handong Zhao, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Proposes quality-controllable text-to-image retrieval that uses language models to expand short, ambiguous queries with contextual details and explicit image quality specifications.

entry.title: LST-SLAM: A Stereo Thermal SLAM System for Kilometer-Scale Dynamic Environments

author.name: Zeyu Jiang, Kuan Xu, Changhao Chen

entry.summary: LST-SLAM is a stereo thermal SLAM system for kilometer-scale dynamic environments, combining self-supervised thermal feature learning with semantic-geometric constraints to suppress dynamic objects.

entry.title: Sample-Efficient Learning with Online Expert Correction for Autonomous Catheter Steering in Endovascular Bifurcation Navigation

author.name: Hao Wang, Tianliang Yao, Bo Lu, Zhiqiang Pei, Liu Dong, Lei Ma, Peng Qi

entry.summary: Proposes a sample-efficient RL framework with online expert correction for autonomous catheter steering in endovascular navigation, integrating segmentation-based pose estimation with expert-guided exploration.

entry.title: Acoustic Feedback for Closed-Loop Force Control in Robotic Grinding

author.name: Zongyuan Zhang, Christopher Lehnert, Will N. Browne, Jonathan M. Roberts

entry.summary: AFRG uses a contact microphone to estimate grinding force from audio signals for closed-loop force control in robotic grinding, replacing expensive force sensors with low-cost acoustic feedback.

entry.title: Balancing Multiple Objectives in Urban Traffic Control with Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback

author.name: Chenyang Zhao, Vinny Cahill, Ivana Dusparic

entry.summary: Applies RLAIF (RL from AI feedback) to multi-objective urban traffic control, using LLMs to generate preference labels for balancing conflicting objectives like throughput and emissions.

entry.title: OpenPort Protocol: A Security Governance Specification for AI Agent Tool Access

author.name: Genliang Zhu, Chu Wang, Ziyuan Wang, Zhida Li, Qiang Li

entry.summary: Introduces OpenPort Protocol (OPP), a governance-first specification for secure AI agent tool access, covering authorization, audit logging, and abuse resistance in a model-neutral framework.

entry.title: MultiModalPFN: Extending Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Multimodal Tabular Learning

author.name: Wall Kim, Chaeyoung Song, Hanul Kim

entry.summary: Extends TabPFN to handle multimodal tabular data (images, text) through MMPFN with modality projectors including multi-head gated MLP and cross-attention pooler.

entry.title: Hierarchical Molecular Representation Learning via Fragment-Based Self-Supervised Embedding Prediction

author.name: Jiele Wu, Haozhe Ma, Zhihan Guo, Thanh Vinh Vo, Tze Yun Leong

entry.summary: Proposes GraSPNet, a hierarchical self-supervised framework for molecular graph learning that explicitly models both atomic-level and fragment-level semantics by decomposing molecules into chemically meaningful fragments.

entry.title: TrajGPT-R: Generating Urban Mobility Trajectory with Reinforcement Learning-Enhanced Generative Pre-trained Transformer

author.name: Jiawei Wang, Chuang Yang, Jiawei Yong, Xiaohang Xu, Hongjun Wang, Noboru Koshizuka, Shintaro Fukushima, Ryosuke Shibasaki, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces TrajGPT-R, a transformer-based framework for generating urban mobility trajectories using offline reinforcement learning and inverse RL to capture trajectory-level reward signals.

entry.title: Multimodal MRI Report Findings Supervised Brain Lesion Segmentation with Substructures

author.name: Yubin Ge, Yongsong Huang, Xiaofeng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes report-supervised brain lesion segmentation that handles multi-parametric MRI with hierarchical report findings, addressing challenges of qualitative/uncertain cues and partial annotations.

entry.title: Tensor Network Generator-Enhanced Optimization for Traveling Salesman Problem

author.name: Ryo Sakai, Chen-Yu Liu

entry.summary: Applies tensor network generator-enhanced optimization (TN-GEO) with matrix product states to the traveling salesman problem, using permutation-based formulation with autoregressive sampling to guarantee valid tours.

entry.title: Discrete Diffusion with Sample-Efficient Estimators for Conditionals

author.name: Karthik Elamvazhuthi, Abhijith Jayakumar, Andrey Y. Lokhov

entry.summary: Proposes a discrete diffusion framework using Neural Interaction Screening Estimator (NeurISE) for sample-efficient estimation of single-site conditionals, treating them as fundamental objects rather than approximating score functions. Tested on Ising models, MNIST, and quantum annealer data.

entry.title: $\kappa$-Explorer: A Unified Framework for Active Model Estimation in MDPs

author.name: Xihe Gu, Urbashi Mitra, Tara Javidi

entry.summary: Introduces κ-Explorer, a parameterized family of objective functions for active model estimation in tabular MDPs that unifies average-case and worst-case exploration objectives through a curvature parameter.

entry.title: SMaRT: Online Reusable Resource Assignment and an Application to Mediation in the Kenyan Judiciary

author.name: Shafkat Farabi, Didac Marti Pinto, Wei Lu, Manuel Ramos-Maqueda, Sanmay Das, Antoine Deeb, Anja Sautmann

entry.summary: Introduces SMaRT for online reusable resource allocation applied to mediator assignment in the Kenyan judiciary, handling 2000+ mediators and 87 geographic locations with quality learning and capacity constraints.

entry.title: PhyGHT: Physics-Guided HyperGraph Transformer for Signal Purification at the HL-LHC

author.name: Mohammed Rakib, Luke Vaughan, Shivang Patel, Flera Rizatdinova, Alexander Khanov, Atriya Sen

entry.summary: Introduces PhyGHT, a physics-guided hypergraph transformer for signal purification at the HL-LHC, combining local graph attention with global self-attention to handle ~200 simultaneous pileup collisions.

entry.title: GSNR: Graph Smooth Null-Space Representation for Inverse Problems

author.name: Romario Gualdr\'on-Hurtado, Roman Jacome, Rafael S. Suarez, Henry Arguello

entry.summary: Proposes GSNR, a method for inverse problems that imposes graph-smooth structure only on the null-space component of reconstructions, avoiding bias from general image priors. Uses a null-restricted graph Laplacian.

entry.title: BiRQA: Bidirectional Robust Quality Assessment for Images

author.name: Aleksandr Gushchin, Dmitriy S. Vatolin, Anastasia Antsiferova

entry.summary: Presents BiRQA, a compact full-reference image quality assessment metric using bidirectional multiscale pyramids with uncertainty-aware gating. Introduces Anchored Adversarial Training for robustness against adversarial perturbations.

entry.title: Pip-Stereo: Progressive Iterations Pruner for Iterative Optimization based Stereo Matching

author.name: Jintu Zheng, Qizhe Liu, HuangXin Xu, Zhuojie Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Pip-Stereo, a pruning-based approach for efficient iterative stereo matching that exploits spatial sparsity and temporal redundancy in disparity updates. Includes FlashGRU, a hardware-aware RNN operator for edge deployment.

entry.title: Beyond Human Performance: A Vision-Language Multi-Agent Approach for Quality Control in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

author.name: Subhra Jyoti Mandal, Lara Rachidi, Puneet Jain, Matthieu Duvinage, Sander W. Timmer

entry.summary: Presents a multi-agent VLM system for pharmaceutical colony-forming unit detection that surpasses human performance, achieving 99% detection rate. Uses Detectron2 with GPT-4o-based agentic validation.

entry.title: WildGHand: Learning Anti-Perturbation Gaussian Hand Avatars from Monocular In-the-Wild Videos

author.name: Hanhui Li, Xuan Huang, Wanquan Liu, Yuhao Cheng, Long Chen, Yiqiang Yan, Xiaodan Liang, Chenqiang Gao

entry.summary: Introduces WildGHand for 3D hand avatar reconstruction from in-the-wild monocular videos, using dynamic perturbation disentanglement to handle hand-object interactions, extreme poses, and other real-world degradations.

entry.title: An interactive enhanced driving dataset for autonomous driving

author.name: Haojie Feng, Peizhi Zhang, Mengjie Tian, Xinrui Zhang, Zhuoren Li, Junpeng Huang, Xiurong Wang, Junfan Zhu, Jianzhou Wang, Dongxiao Yin, Lu Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes the Interactive Enhanced Driving Dataset (IEDD) for autonomous driving, mining interactive scenarios from naturalistic data and constructing VQA-aligned BEV videos for training Vision-Language-Action models.

entry.title: RecoverMark: Robust Watermarking for Localization and Recovery of Manipulated Faces

author.name: Haonan An, Xiaohui Ye, Guang Hua, Yihang Tao, Hangcheng Cao, Xiangyu Yu, Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: RecoverMark proposes a robust watermarking framework for detecting and recovering manipulated face regions, addressing vulnerabilities of fragile watermarks against removal attacks. It tackles the dual-watermark interference problem where robust and fragile watermarks degrade each other's effectiveness.

entry.title: Monocular Endoscopic Tissue 3D Reconstruction with Multi-Level Geometry Regularization

author.name: Yangsen Chen, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a 3D Gaussian Splatting approach for endoscopic tissue reconstruction with multi-level geometry regularization, combining SDF-based mesh constraints with local rigidity for physically plausible deformations. Targets real-time rendering for robot-assisted surgery.

entry.title: RU4D-SLAM: Reweighting Uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting SLAM for 4D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Yangfan Zhao, Hanwei Zhang, Ke Huang, Qiufeng Wang, Zhenzhou Shao, Dengyu Wu

entry.summary: RU4D-SLAM extends Gaussian Splatting SLAM to 4D scene reconstruction in dynamic environments, introducing uncertainty reweighting to handle moving objects that complicate both reconstruction and tracking.

entry.title: Testing Effect Homogeneity and Confounding in High-Dimensional Experimental and Observational Studies

author.name: Ana Armendariz, Martin Huber

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for testing whether conditional average treatment effects are homogeneous across multiple experimental and observational studies, enabling detection of unobserved confounding by comparing CATEs between experimental and observational data.

entry.title: Adjacency Spectral Embeddings of Correlation Networks

author.name: Keith Levin

entry.summary: Provides theoretical justification for using adjacency spectral embeddings on correlation networks (where edges are pairwise correlations of time series), showing these correspond to latent space network models when time series have sparse Fourier representations.

entry.title: Motivation is Something You Need

author.name: Mehdi Acheli, Walid Gaaloul

entry.summary: Proposes a neuroscience-inspired training paradigm where a smaller model trains continuously while a larger 'motivated' model activates intermittently during notable training moments, mimicking the SEEKING emotional state.

entry.title: Mitigating "Epistemic Debt" in Generative AI-Scaffolded Novice Programming using Metacognitive Scripts

author.name: Sreecharan Sankaranarayanan

entry.summary: Proposes metacognitive scripts to mitigate 'epistemic debt' in novice programmers using LLM-assisted coding, drawing on cognitive load theory to distinguish cognitive offloading from outsourcing.

entry.title: Maximin Share Guarantees via Limited Cost-Sensitive Sharing

author.name: Hana Salavcova, Martin \v{C}ern\'y, Arpita Biswas

entry.summary: Studies fair allocation of indivisible goods with limited cost-sensitive sharing, proving that exact maximin share allocations exist when goods can be shared among at least half the agents.

entry.title: SurgAtt-Tracker: Online Surgical Attention Tracking via Temporal Proposal Reranking and Motion-Aware Refinement

author.name: Rulin Zhou, Guankun Wang, An Wang, Yujie Ma, Lixin Ouyang, Bolin Cui, Junyan Li, Chaowei Zhu, Mingyang Li, Ming Chen, Xiaopin Zhong, Peng Lu, Jiankun Wang, Xianming Liu, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes SurgAtt-Tracker for surgical attention tracking, formulating it as a spatio-temporal learning problem with dense attention heatmaps for continuous field-of-view guidance in minimally invasive surgery.

entry.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Online Learning

author.name: Guixian Chen, Salar Fattahi, Soroosh Shafiee

entry.summary: Studies distributionally robust online learning with Wasserstein ambiguity sets, formulating it as an online saddle-point game and proposing a framework that converges to robust Nash equilibrium.

entry.title: CREDIT: Certified Ownership Verification of Deep Neural Networks Against Model Extraction Attacks

author.name: Bolin Shen, Zhan Cheng, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, Fan Yao, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Introduces CREDIT, a certified ownership verification method for DNNs against model extraction attacks using mutual information-based theoretical guarantees.
