entry.summary: Investigates using influence functions to detect labeling bias in training data, where unequal error rates across subgroups or misrepresented prevalence undermine fairness constraints that assume clean labels.

entry.title: UP-Fuse: Uncertainty-guided LiDAR-Camera Fusion for 3D Panoptic Segmentation

author.name: Rohit Mohan, Florian Drews, Yakov Miron, Daniele Cattaneo, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: UP-Fuse proposes uncertainty-aware LiDAR-camera fusion in range-view for 3D panoptic segmentation that remains robust under camera sensor degradation, calibration drift, and failure.

entry.title: Red-Teaming Claude Opus and ChatGPT-based Security Advisors for Trusted Execution Environments

author.name: Kunal Mukherjee

entry.summary: Red-teams Claude Opus and ChatGPT as TEE security advisors, testing for hallucinated mechanisms, overclaimed attestation guarantees, and unsafe behavior under adversarial prompting.

entry.title: Denoising Particle Filters: Learning State Estimation with Single-Step Objectives

author.name: Lennart R\"ostel, Berthold B\"auml

entry.summary: Proposes Denoising Particle Filters that learn measurement models via denoising score matching and combine with dynamics models for state estimation in robotics, avoiding expensive sequential training.

entry.title: Rethinking LoRA for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning in Large Models

author.name: Jin Liu, Yinbin Miao, Ning Xi, Junkang Liu

entry.summary: Rethinks LoRA for differentially private federated learning, identifying three challenges (gradient coupling, noise amplification, loss landscape sharpness) and proposing solutions for large vision and language models.

entry.title: Contextual Safety Reasoning and Grounding for Open-World Robots

author.name: Zachary Ravichadran, David Snyder, Alexander Robey, Hamed Hassani, Vijay Kumar, George J. Pappas

entry.summary: CORE is a safety framework for robots in open-world environments that uses VLMs for continuous contextual reasoning about safety rules from visual observations, without requiring prior maps or specifications.

entry.title: NanoKnow: How to Know What Your Language Model Knows

author.name: Lingwei Gu, Nour Jedidi, Jimmy Lin

entry.summary: Releases NanoKnow, a benchmark that partitions questions by whether answers exist in nanochat's open pre-training data, enabling disentanglement of parametric vs. other knowledge sources in LLMs.

entry.title: Measuring the Prevalence of Policy Violating Content with ML Assisted Sampling and LLM Labeling

author.name: Attila Dobi, Aravindh Manickavasagam, Benjamin Thompson, Xiaohan Yang, Faisal Farooq

entry.summary: Presents a system for measuring prevalence of policy-violating content on platforms using ML-assisted probability sampling and multimodal LLM labeling. Combines importance sampling with LLM-based annotation to produce unbiased prevalence estimates at scale.

entry.title: Adaptive Time Series Reasoning via Segment Selection

author.name: Shvat Messica, Jiawen Zhang, Kevin Li, Theodoros Tsiligkaridis, Marinka Zitnik

entry.summary: ARTIST formulates time-series reasoning as a sequential decision problem, interleaving reasoning with adaptive temporal segment selection. Uses a controller-reasoner architecture trained with RL to select informative segments rather than encoding the full series.

entry.title: SGNO: Spectral Generator Neural Operators for Stable Long Horizon PDE Rollouts

author.name: Jiayi Li, Zhaonan Wang, Flora D. Salim

entry.summary: SGNO is a neural operator for PDEs using exponential time differencing in Fourier space with a learned diagonal generator constrained to be non-dissipative, targeting stable long-horizon autoregressive rollouts.

entry.title: Conditionally Site-Independent Neural Evolution of Antibody Sequences

author.name: Stephen Zhewen Lu, Aakarsh Vermani, Kohei Sanno, Jiarui Lu, Frederick A Matsen, Milind Jagota, Yun S. Song

entry.summary: CoSiNE is a continuous-time Markov chain parameterized by a neural network for modeling antibody evolution, bridging deep learning expressivity with phylogenetic evolutionary dynamics for antibody engineering.

entry.title: Adaptive Problem Generation via Symbolic Representations

author.name: Teresa Yeo, Myeongho Jeon, Dulaj Weerakoon, Rui Qiao, Alok Prakash, Armando Solar-Lezama, Archan Misra

entry.summary: Presents a method for generating adaptive training data for RL with verifiable rewards, operating in a symbolic problem space to enable precise control over problem structure and automatic ground-truth generation.

entry.title: The Sample Complexity of Replicable Realizable PAC Learning

author.name: Kasper Green Larsen, Markus Engelund Mathiasen, Chirag Pabbaraju, Clement Svendsen

entry.summary: Proves a sample complexity lower bound with near-(log|H|)^{3/2} dependence for replicable realizable PAC learning using Cayley graph analysis, with an almost matching upper bound for the hard instance.

entry.title: Understanding the Curse of Unrolling

author.name: Sheheryar Mehmood, Florian Knoll, Peter Ochs

entry.summary: Provides a non-asymptotic analysis explaining the 'curse of unrolling' - where derivative iterates initially diverge from true Jacobians when differentiating through iterative algorithms. Shows that truncating early iterations mitigates this while reducing memory.

entry.title: Expanding the Role of Diffusion Models for Robust Classifier Training

author.name: Pin-Han Huang, Shang-Tse Chen, Hsuan-Tien Lin

entry.summary: Shows that internal representations of diffusion models can serve as auxiliary learning signals for adversarial training beyond just generating synthetic data. Demonstrates that diffusion representations are partially robust and improve robustness when incorporated into AT.

entry.title: Triggering hallucinations in model-based MRI reconstruction via adversarial perturbations

author.name: Suna Bu\u{g}day, Yvan Saeys, Jonathan Peck

entry.summary: Demonstrates that adversarial perturbations can trigger hallucinations in generative models used for MRI reconstruction, showing these models can insert features not present in original images.

entry.title: Rethinking Chronological Causal Discovery with Signal Processing

author.name: Kurt Butler, Damian Machlanski, Panagiotis Dimitrakopoulos, Sotirios A. Tsaftaris

entry.summary: Examines sensitivity of causal discovery methods to sampling rate and window length mismatches between data recording and underlying events. Demonstrates that both classical and recent methods are significantly affected by these signal processing considerations.

entry.title: Anatomy of Unlearning: The Dual Impact of Fact Salience and Model Fine-Tuning

author.name: Borisiuk Anna, Andrey Savchenko, Alexander Panchecko, Elena Tutubalina

entry.summary: Introduces DUAL benchmark (28.6k triplets) for studying machine unlearning with fact popularity annotations. Shows pretrained and SFT models respond differently to unlearning, with SFT yielding smoother forgetting and 10-50% higher retention.

entry.title: Morphological Addressing of Identity Basins in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

author.name: Andrew Fraser

entry.summary: Shows that identity basins in text-to-image diffusion models can be navigated using morphological descriptors (physical features) without using a target person's name or photos. A self-distillation loop with LoRA achieves convergence toward specific identities.

entry.title: Driving with A Thousand Faces: A Benchmark for Closed-Loop Personalized End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xiaoru Dong, Ruiqin Li, Xiao Han, Zhenxuan Wu, Jiamin Wang, Jian Chen, Qi Jiang, SM Yiu, Xinge Zhu, Yuexin Ma

entry.summary: Introduces Person2Drive, a benchmark and platform for personalized end-to-end autonomous driving that includes data collection, style metrics, and algorithms for learning individual driving styles. Addresses the gap that most AD systems learn only average driving behavior.

entry.title: PhysConvex: Physics-Informed 3D Dynamic Convex Radiance Fields for Reconstruction and Simulation

author.name: Dan Wang, Xinrui Cui, Serge Belongie, Ravi Ramamoorthi

entry.summary: Proposes PhysConvex, a physics-informed 3D dynamic convex radiance field that unifies visual rendering and physical simulation using convex primitives governed by continuum mechanics for deformable scene reconstruction.

entry.title: Marginalized Bundle Adjustment: Multi-View Camera Pose from Monocular Depth Estimates

author.name: Shengjie Zhu, Ahmed Abdelkader, Mark J. Matthews, Xiaoming Liu, Wen-Sheng Chu

entry.summary: Proposes Marginalized Bundle Adjustment (MBA) to integrate monocular depth estimation into Structure-from-Motion by mitigating MDE error variance through density. Shows MDE depth maps are sufficiently accurate for SoTA SfM and relocalization.

entry.title: SeaCache: Spectral-Evolution-Aware Cache for Accelerating Diffusion Models

author.name: Jiwoo Chung, Sangeek Hyun, MinKyu Lee, Byeongju Han, Geonho Cha, Dongyoon Wee, Youngjun Hong, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Introduces SeaCache, a training-free cache scheduling method for accelerating diffusion model inference that bases reuse decisions on spectrally-aligned representations, recognizing that low-frequency structure appears early and high-frequency detail later.

entry.title: StreetTree: A Large-Scale Global Benchmark for Fine-Grained Tree Species Classification

author.name: Jiapeng Li, Yingjing Huang, Fan Zhang, Yu liu

entry.summary: Introduces StreetTree, the world's first large-scale benchmark for fine-grained street tree classification with 12M+ images covering 8,300+ species from 133 countries. Collected from urban streetscapes with expert verification.

entry.title: Flash-VAED: Plug-and-Play VAE Decoders for Efficient Video Generation

author.name: Lunjie Zhu, Yushi Huang, Xingtong Ge, Yufei Xue, Zhening Liu, Yumeng Zhang, Zehong Lin, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Flash-VAED, a universal acceleration framework for VAE decoders in video generation that uses independence-aware channel pruning and stage-wise dominant operator optimization to reduce latency while maintaining quality.

entry.title: Vinedresser3D: Agentic Text-guided 3D Editing

author.name: Yankuan Chi, Xiang Li, Zixuan Huang, James M. Rehg

entry.summary: Introduces Vinedresser3D, an agentic framework for text-guided 3D editing that uses an MLLM agent to decompose editing instructions, identify edit regions and types, and apply edits in the latent space of a native 3D generative model.

entry.title: ApET: Approximation-Error Guided Token Compression for Efficient VLMs

author.name: Qiankun Ma, Ziyao Zhang, Haofei Wang, Jie Chen, Zhen Song, Hairong Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes ApET, a visual token compression method for VLMs guided by approximation error from an information-theoretic perspective, avoiding attention-based dependencies and maintaining compatibility with FlashAttention.

entry.title: Fine-Pruning: A Biologically Inspired Algorithm for Personalization of Machine Learning Models

author.name: Joseph Bingham, Saman Zonouz, Dvir Aran

entry.summary: Proposes Fine-Pruning, a biologically inspired algorithm that mimics brain pruning for model personalization, achieving results with orders of magnitude fewer computational resources and no labels. Successfully personalizes speech recognition and other models.

entry.title: Distribution-Free Sequential Prediction with Abstentions

author.name: Jialin Yu, Mo\"ise Blanchard

entry.summary: Studies distribution-free sequential prediction with abstentions in a semi-adversarial setting where the learner can abstain on corrupted instances. Extends learnability results between stochastic and adversarial settings.

entry.title: Pre-training data poisoning likely makes installing secret loyalties easier

author.name: Joe Kwon

entry.summary: Argues that pre-training data poisoning serves as a primer for post-training attacks on AI loyalty, by installing knowledge and representations that reduce the amount of post-training data needed to instill behavioral dispositions.

entry.title: Federated Reasoning Distillation Framework with Model Learnability-Aware Data Allocation

author.name: Wei Guo, Siyuan Lu, Xiangdong Ran, Yiqi Tong, Yikun Ban, Zelong Xu, Jing Fan, Zixuan Huang, Xiao Zhang, Zhaojun Hu, Fuzhen Zhuang

entry.summary: Proposes a federated reasoning distillation framework that addresses bidirectional model learnability gaps between LLMs and small language models, with model-aware data allocation for effective knowledge transfer in federated settings.

entry.title: TPRU: Advancing Temporal and Procedural Understanding in Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Zhenkun Gao, Xuhong Wang, Xin Tan, Yuan Xie

entry.summary: Introduces TPRU, a large-scale dataset for training MLLMs on temporal and procedural understanding through tasks like temporal reordering and frame prediction in embodied scenarios. Addresses a critical deficiency in current smaller multimodal models.

entry.title: Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models. Lessons Learned from General Game Playing

author.name: Maciej \'Swiechowski, Adam \.Zychowski, Jacek Ma\'ndziuk

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM reasoning through General Game Playing tasks, testing Gemini 2.5, Llama 3.3, and GPT-OSS on forward simulation, multi-step state formulation, and legal action generation. Analyzes correlations between 40 structural game features and LLM performance.

entry.title: ComplLLM: Fine-tuning LLMs to Discover Complementary Signals for Decision-making

author.name: Ziyang Guo, Yifan Wu, Jason Hartline, Kenneth Holstein, Jessica Hullman

entry.summary: Proposes ComplLLM, a framework that fine-tunes LLMs to output signals complementary to existing agent decisions, based on decision theory. Demonstrates recovery of known complementary information in synthetic and real-world tasks.

entry.title: Red Teaming LLMs as Socio-Technical Practice: From Exploration and Data Creation to Evaluation

author.name: Adriana Alvarado Garcia, Ruyuan Wan, Ozioma C. Oguine, Karla Badillo-Urquiola

entry.summary: Qualitative study of 22 practitioners examining socio-technical practices of red teaming LLMs, focusing on how adversarial datasets are defined, created, and evaluated. Provides empirical evidence of practices and challenges in this emerging field.

entry.title: RDBLearn: Simple In-Context Prediction Over Relational Databases

author.name: Yanlin Zhang, Linjie Xu, Quan Gan, David Wipf, Minjie Wang

entry.summary: RDBLearn extends tabular in-context learning to relational databases by automatically featurizing target rows using relational aggregations, then running tabular foundation models on the augmented table. Shows this simple recipe is effective across relational prediction tasks.

entry.title: From Static Spectra to Operando Infrared Dynamics: Physics Informed Flow Modeling and a Benchmark

author.name: Shuquan Ye, Ben Fei, Hongbin Xu, Jiaying Lin, Wanli Ouyang

entry.summary: Introduces OpIRSpec-7K, the first large-scale operando infrared spectroscopy dataset for lithium-ion batteries, and proposes physics-informed flow modeling to predict time-resolved spectral evolution from a single static spectrum.

entry.title: MiSCHiEF: A Benchmark in Minimal-Pairs of Safety and Culture for Holistic Evaluation of Fine-Grained Image-Caption Alignment

author.name: Sagarika Banerjee, Tangatar Madi, Advait Swaminathan, Nguyen Dao Minh Anh, Shivank Garg, Kevin Zhu, Vasu Sharma

entry.summary: MiSCHiEF is a contrastive-pair benchmark for fine-grained image-caption alignment in safety and cultural contexts, testing VLMs on minimally differing image-caption pairs where subtle differences have significant semantic consequences.

entry.title: UFO: Unlocking Ultra-Efficient Quantized Private Inference with Protocol and Algorithm Co-Optimization

author.name: Wenxuan Zeng, Chao Yang, Tianshi Xu, Bo Zhang, Changrui Ren, Jin Dong, Meng Li

entry.summary: UFO jointly optimizes 2PC protocols and quantization for private CNN inference, combining Winograd convolution with quantization while addressing challenges of inference overflow and quantization-aware training instability.

entry.title: Adaptive Collaboration of Arena-Based Argumentative LLMs for Explainable and Contestable Legal Reasoning

author.name: Hoang-Loc Cao, Phuc Ho, Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen, Phuc Truong Loc Nguyen, Dinh Thien Loc Nguyen, Hung Cao

entry.summary: ACAL proposes a neuro-symbolic framework combining adaptive multi-agent LLM collaboration with quantitative bipolar argumentation for explainable and contestable legal reasoning, achieving strong performance on legal benchmarks.

entry.title: Give Users the Wheel: Towards Promptable Recommendation Paradigm

author.name: Fuyuan Lyu, Chenglin Luo, Qiyuan Zhang, Yupeng Hou, Haolun Wu, Xing Tang, Xue Liu, Jin L. C. Guo, Xiuqiang He

entry.summary: Proposes a promptable recommendation paradigm where users can express intent via natural language prompts, decoupling intent understanding (via LLMs) from ID-based retrieval to combine the best of both approaches.

entry.title: HistCAD: Geometrically Constrained Parametric History-based CAD Dataset

author.name: Xintong Dong, Chuanyang Li, Chuqi Han, Peng Zheng, Jiaxin Jing, Yanzhi Song, Zhouwang Yang

entry.summary: HistCAD is a large-scale parametric CAD dataset with explicit geometric constraints, modeling sequences, multi-view renderings, STEP B-reps, native parametric files, and LLM-generated textual annotations across five aligned modalities.

entry.title: Active perception and disentangled representations allow continual, episodic zero and few-shot learning

author.name: David Rawlinson, Gideon Kowadlo

entry.summary: Proposes a Complementary Learning System where the fast learner foregoes generalization for continual zero-shot and few-shot learning using active perception and disentangled representations.

entry.title: Localized Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via High-Level Representation Misdirection

author.name: Uichan Lee, Jeonghyeon Kim, Sangheum Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes localized concept erasure in text-to-image diffusion models by fine-tuning early self-attention layers of the text encoder rather than the U-Net, based on causal tracing insights about where visual attributes are localized.

entry.title: Hexagon-MLIR: An AI Compilation Stack For Qualcomm's Neural Processing Units (NPUs)

author.name: Mohammed Javed Absar, Muthu Baskaran, Abhikrant Sharma, Abhilash Bhandari, Ankit Aggarwal, Arun Rangasamy, Dibyendu Das, Fateme Hosseini, Franck Slama, Iulian Brumar, Jyotsna Verma, Krishnaprasad Bindumadhavan, Mitesh Kothari, Mohit Gupta, Ravishankar Kolachana, Richard Lethin, Samarth Narang, Sanjay Motilal Ladwa, Shalini Jain, Snigdha Suresh Dalvi, Tasmia Rahman, Venkat Rasagna Reddy Komatireddy, Vivek Vasudevbhai Pandya, Xiyue Shi, Zachary Zipper

entry.summary: Presents Hexagon-MLIR, an open-source MLIR-based compilation stack for Qualcomm's Neural Processing Units, supporting both Triton kernels and PyTorch models for efficient AI deployment on NPUs.

entry.title: DP-FedAdamW: An Efficient Optimizer for Differentially Private Federated Large Models

author.name: Jin Liu, Yinbin Miao, Ning Xi, Junkang Liu

entry.summary: DP-FedAdamW is the first AdamW-based optimizer designed for differentially private federated learning, addressing variance amplification, bias, and client drift caused by DP perturbations.

entry.title: NovaPlan: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Manipulation via Closed-Loop Video Language Planning

author.name: Jiahui Fu, Junyu Nan, Lingfeng Sun, Hongyu Li, Jianing Qian, Jennifer L. Barry, Kris Kitani, George Konidaris

entry.summary: NovaPlan is a hierarchical framework for zero-shot long-horizon robotic manipulation that combines closed-loop VLM planning with video generation and geometrically grounded execution.

entry.title: Learning Invariant Visual Representations for Planning with Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models

author.name: Leonardo F. Toso, Davit Shadunts, Yunyang Lu, Nihal Sharma, Donglin Zhan, Nam H. Nguyen, James Anderson

entry.summary: Augments JEPA-style world models with a bisimulation encoder that enforces control-relevant state equivalence, addressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual 'slow features' like background changes in latent predictive models like DINO-WM.

entry.title: From Few-Shot to Zero-Shot: Towards Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yixin Liu, Shiyuan Li, Yu Zheng, Qingfeng Chen, Chengqi Zhang, Philip S. Yu, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Proposes a generalist graph anomaly detection paradigm that aims for zero-shot transfer across datasets, moving beyond the one-model-per-dataset approach that limits generalization and raises privacy concerns.

entry.title: L2G-Net: Local to Global Spectral Graph Neural Networks via Cauchy Factorizations

author.name: Samuel Fern\'andez-Mendui\~na, Eduardo Pavez, Antonio Ortega

entry.summary: L2G-Net introduces a novel factorization of the graph Fourier transform into subgraph operators combined via Cauchy matrices, enabling spectral GNNs that capture long-range dependencies while maintaining vertex-domain locality.

entry.title: Exponential Convergence of (Stochastic) Gradient Descent for Separable Logistic Regression

author.name: Sacchit Kale, Piyushi Manupriya, Pierre Marion, Francis bach, Anant Raj

entry.summary: Proves that gradient descent with a simple increasing step-size schedule achieves exponential convergence for separable logistic regression without requiring instability or edge-of-stability dynamics.

entry.title: Incremental Transformer Neural Processes

author.name: Philip Mortimer, Cristiana Diaconu, Tommy Rochussen, Bruno Mlodozeniec, Richard E. Turner

entry.summary: Incremental TNP extends Transformer Neural Processes with causal masking and KV caching for sequential data streams, enabling cheap incremental updates instead of recomputing from scratch for each new observation.

entry.title: TimeRadar: A Domain-Rotatable Foundation Model for Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Hui He, Hezhe Qiao, Yutong Chen, Kun Yi, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: TimeRadar is a time series foundation model operating in a fractional time-frequency domain for anomaly detection, using domain rotation to distinguish abnormal patterns that look similar to normal ones in fixed domains.

entry.title: Training-Free Cross-Architecture Merging for Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Rishabh Bhattacharya, Vikaskumar Kalsariya, Naresh Manwani

entry.summary: H-GRAMA enables training-free cross-architecture GNN merging by lifting parameter-space merging to operator space through a Universal Message Passing Mixture formalization.

entry.title: Boltzmann Generators for Condensed Matter via Riemannian Flow Matching

author.name: Emil Hoffmann, Maximilian Schebek, Leon Klein, Frank No\'e, Jutta Rogal

entry.summary: Applies Riemannian flow matching to build Boltzmann generators for condensed matter systems, incorporating periodicity and using Hutchinson's trace estimator with bias correction for efficient density estimation.

entry.title: Neural Fields as World Models

author.name: Joshua Nunley

entry.summary: Proposes isomorphic world models that preserve sensory topology using neural fields with motor-gated channels, arguing physics prediction should be geometric propagation rather than abstract state transitions. Shows local connectivity suffices for ballistic physics.

entry.title: Vid2Sid: Videos Can Help Close the Sim2Real Gap

author.name: Kevin Qiu, Yu Zhang, Marek Cygan, Josie Hughes

entry.summary: Presents Vid2Sid, a video-driven system identification pipeline that couples foundation-model perception with VLM-in-the-loop optimization to diagnose sim-real physics mismatches with natural language rationales.

entry.title: Manifold-Aligned Generative Transport

author.name: Xinyu Tian, Xiaotong Shen

entry.summary: Proposes MAGT (Manifold-Aligned Generative Transport), a flow-like generator that learns one-shot manifold-aligned transport from low-dimensional base distributions. Aims to balance support fidelity with sampling efficiency, addressing limitations of both diffusion models and normalizing flows.

entry.title: The Invisible Gorilla Effect in Out-of-distribution Detection

author.name: Harry Anthony, Ziyun Liang, Hermione Warr, Konstantinos Kamnitsas

entry.summary: Identifies a bias in OOD detection where performance improves when artefacts share visual similarity with the model's region of interest and drops when they don't, coined the 'Invisible Gorilla Effect'. Provides analysis of this previously unreported phenomenon.

entry.title: AgenticRAGTracer: A Hop-Aware Benchmark for Diagnosing Multi-Step Retrieval Reasoning in Agentic RAG

author.name: Qijie You, Wenkai Yu, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticRAGTracer, a benchmark for diagnosing multi-step retrieval reasoning in agentic RAG systems with hop-level intermediate questions. Enables fine-grained analysis of where agents fail in multi-hop reasoning.

entry.title: Watermarking LLM Agent Trajectories

author.name: Wenlong Meng, Chen Gong, Terry Yue Zhuo, Fan Zhang, Kecen Li, Zheng Liu, Zhou Yang, Chengkun Wei, Wenzhi Chen

entry.summary: Introduces ActHook, the first watermarking method for LLM agent trajectory datasets. Embeds hook actions triggered by secret keys that don't alter task outcomes, enabling copyright protection and misuse tracing for expensive trajectory data.

entry.title: IRIS-SLAM: Unified Geo-Instance Representations for Robust Semantic Localization and Mapping

author.name: Tingyang Xiao, Liu Liu, Wei Feng, Zhengyu Zou, Xiaolin Zhou, Wei Sui, Hao Li, Dingwen Zhang, Zhizhong Su

entry.summary: Proposes IRIS-SLAM, an RGB semantic SLAM system that extends geometry foundation models to predict both dense geometry and cross-view consistent instance embeddings, enabling semantic-synergized data association and instance-guided loop closure.

entry.title: SafeDrive: Fine-Grained Safety Reasoning for End-to-End Driving in a Sparse World

author.name: Jungho Kim, Jiyong Oh, Seunghoon Yu, Hongjae Shin, Donghyuk Kwak, Jun Won Choi

entry.summary: Proposes SafeDrive, an end-to-end autonomous driving planning framework with explicit safety reasoning through a trajectory-conditioned Sparse World Model that simulates future behaviors of critical agents and road entities.

entry.title: Frame2Freq: Spectral Adapters for Fine-Grained Video Understanding

author.name: Thinesh Thiyakesan Ponbagavathi, Constantin Seibold, Alina Roitberg

entry.summary: Introduces Frame2Freq, frequency-aware adapters that perform spectral encoding during image-to-video adaptation of pretrained vision foundation models. Uses FFT along time to learn frequency-band-specific embeddings for fine-grained action recognition.

entry.title: TokenTrace: Multi-Concept Attribution through Watermarked Token Recovery

author.name: Li Zhang, Shruti Agarwal, John Collomosse, Pengtao Xie, Vishal Asnani

entry.summary: Introduces TokenTrace, a proactive watermarking framework for multi-concept attribution in generative AI that embeds signatures in both text prompt embeddings and initial latent noise, enabling disentangled attribution of multiple concepts in a single image.

entry.title: CREM: Compression-Driven Representation Enhancement for Multimodal Retrieval and Comprehension

author.name: Lihao Liu, Yan Wang, Biao Yang, Da Li, Jiangxia Cao, Yuxiao Luo, Xiang Chen, Xiangyu Wu, Wei Yuan, Fan Yang, Guiguang Ding, Tingting Gao, Guorui Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes CREM, a unified framework bridging multimodal retrieval and comprehension in MLLMs through compression-driven representation enhancement. Argues both tasks share cognitive mechanisms of cross-modal alignment and contextual comprehension.

entry.title: JavisDiT++: Unified Modeling and Optimization for Joint Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Kai Liu, Yanhao Zheng, Kai Wang, Shengqiong Wu, Rongjunchen Zhang, Jiebo Luo, Dimitrios Hatzinakos, Ziwei Liu, Hao Fei, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Presents JavisDiT++, a framework for joint audio-video generation featuring modality-specific mixture-of-experts and optimization techniques to bridge the gap with commercial models like Veo3 in synchronized audio-video synthesis.

entry.title: PoseCraft: Tokenized 3D Body Landmark and Camera Conditioning for Photorealistic Human Image Synthesis

author.name: Zhilin Guo, Jing Yang, Kyle Fogarty, Jingyi Wan, Boqiao Zhang, Tianhao Wu, Weihao Xia, Chenliang Zhou, Sakar Khattar, Fangcheng Zhong, Cristina Nader Vasconcelos, Cengiz Oztireli

entry.summary: Presents PoseCraft, a diffusion framework for photorealistic human image synthesis that tokenizes 3D body landmarks and camera extrinsics as discrete conditioning tokens injected via cross-attention, avoiding 2D re-projection ambiguity under large pose/viewpoint changes.

entry.title: Decoupling Vision and Language: Codebook Anchored Visual Adaptation

author.name: Jason Wu, Tianchen Zhao, Chang Liu, Jiarui Cai, Zheng Zhang, Zhuowei Li, Aaditya Singh, Xiang Xu, Mani Srivastava, Jonathan Wu

entry.summary: Introduces CRAFT, a lightweight method that fine-tunes vision encoders using a discrete codebook as an intermediary, decoupling the vision encoder from the language model in LVLMs. Enables modular encoder adaptation without re-alignment.

entry.title: Test-Time Computing for Referring Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Mingrui Wu, Hao Chen, Jiayi Ji, Xiaoshuai Sun, Zhiyuan Liu, Liujuan Cao, Ming-Ming Cheng, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Proposes ControlMLLM++, a test-time adaptation framework that injects learnable visual prompts into frozen MLLMs for region-based visual reasoning without retraining. Optimizes visual token modifiers during inference using task-specific energy functions.

entry.title: One2Scene: Geometric Consistent Explorable 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image

author.name: Pengfei Wang, Liyi Chen, Zhiyuan Ma, Yanjun Guo, Guowen Zhang, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces One2Scene, a framework for generating explorable 3D scenes from a single image by decomposing the problem into panorama generation, 3D scaffold construction via feed-forward Gaussian Splatting, and novel view synthesis.

entry.title: TextShield-R1: Reinforced Reasoning for Tampered Text Detection

author.name: Chenfan Qu, Yiwu Zhong, Jian Liu, Xuekang Zhu, Bohan Yu, Lianwen Jin

entry.summary: Introduces TextShield-R1, the first RL-based MLLM solution for tampered text detection and reasoning, using forensic continual pre-training with easy-to-hard curriculum and reinforcement learning for improved forgery detection.

entry.title: FORMICA: Decision-Focused Learning for Communication-Free Multi-Robot Task Allocation

author.name: Antonio Lopez, Jack Muirhead, Carlo Pinciroli

entry.summary: Introduces FORMICA, a learning-based framework for multi-robot task allocation without any robot-to-robot communication. Robots coordinate implicitly by predicting teammates' bids using learned bid distribution models.

entry.title: CLASH: Collision Learning via Augmented Sim-to-real Hybridization to Bridge the Reality Gap

author.name: Haotian He, Ning Guo, Siqi Shi, Qipeng Liu, Wenzhao Lian

entry.summary: Introduces CLASH, a framework that bridges the sim-to-real gap for contact-rich dynamics by learning a surrogate collision model from minimal real-world data, fine-tuning a base model distilled from MuJoCo.

entry.title: Towards Dexterous Embodied Manipulation via Deep Multi-Sensory Fusion and Sparse Expert Scaling

author.name: Yirui Sun, Guangyu Zhuge, Keliang Liu, Jie Gu, Zhihao xia, Qionglin Ren, Chunxu tian, Zhongxue Ga

entry.summary: Presents DeMUSE, a framework using Diffusion Transformer to integrate RGB, depth, and 6-axis force sensing for dexterous manipulation, with adaptive modality normalization and sparse mixture-of-experts for scaling.

entry.title: Task-Aware Exploration via a Predictive Bisimulation Metric

author.name: Dayang Liang, Ruihan Liu, Lipeng Wan, Yunlong Liu, Bo An

entry.summary: Presents TEB, a task-aware exploration method for visual RL under sparse rewards that uses a predictive bisimulation metric to learn task-relevant representations and measure behavioral novelty. Bridges the gap between intrinsic exploration and task-aware strategies in visual domains.

entry.title: LAMMI-Pathology: A Tool-Centric Bottom-Up LVLM-Agent Framework for Molecularly Informed Medical Intelligence in Pathology

author.name: Haoyang Su, Shaoting Zhang, Xiaosong Wang

entry.summary: Introduces LAMMI-Pathology, an agent framework for pathology image analysis that uses tool-calling with spatial transcriptomics data for molecularly informed diagnosis. Uses a bottom-up, tool-centric architecture where domain-adaptive tools are clustered into component agents.

entry.title: Evaluating Large Language Models on Quantum Mechanics: A Comparative Study Across Diverse Models and Tasks

author.name: S. K. Rithvik

entry.summary: Evaluates 15 LLMs across 5 providers on 20 quantum mechanics tasks covering derivations, creative problems, and numerical computation. Finds clear tier stratification with flagship models at 81% accuracy, and that tool augmentation helps numerical but not derivation tasks.

entry.title: Topology of Reasoning: Retrieved Cell Complex-Augmented Generation for Textual Graph Question Answering

author.name: Sen Zhao, Lincheng Zhou, Yue Chen, Ding Zou

entry.summary: Introduces Retrieved Cell Complex-Augmented Generation for graph QA, extending RAG beyond nodes and edges to capture cycles (relational loops) using cell complexes from algebraic topology. Addresses a gap in handling closed-loop reasoning.

entry.title: From Bias Mitigation to Bias Negotiation: Governing Identity and Sociocultural Reasoning in Generative AI

author.name: Zackary Okun Dunivin, Bingyi Han, John Bollenbocher

entry.summary: Introduces 'bias negotiation' as a governance concept beyond bias mitigation, arguing that LLMs need a positive, context-sensitive role for identity in interpretation rather than simply suppressing identity-related signals. Examines when and how AI systems should invoke identity in judgment.

entry.title: DM4CT: Benchmarking Diffusion Models for Computed Tomography Reconstruction

author.name: Jiayang Shi, Daniel M. Pelt, K. Joost Batenburg

entry.summary: DM4CT benchmarks diffusion models for CT reconstruction across medical and industrial domains with sparse-view and noisy configurations, comparing against established reconstruction methods.

entry.title: TAG: Thinking with Action Unit Grounding for Facial Expression Recognition

author.name: Haobo Lin, Tianyi Bai, Jiajun Zhang, Xuanhao Chang, Sheng Lu, Fangming Gu, Zengjie Hu, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: TAG proposes grounding facial expression recognition in Action Units, requiring VLM reasoning steps to be explicitly tied to AU-related facial regions. This reduces hallucination and improves robustness across datasets.

entry.title: Operational Robustness of LLMs on Code Generation

author.name: Debalina Ghosh Paul, Hong Zhu, Ian Bayley

entry.summary: Proposes 'scenario domain analysis' for evaluating LLM robustness in code generation, finding minimal changes in natural language task descriptions that cause incorrect outputs. Formally defines this evaluation method.

entry.title: BiMotion: B-spline Motion for Text-guided Dynamic 3D Character Generation

author.name: Miaowei Wang, Qingxuan Yan, Zhi Cao, Yayuan Li, Oisin Mac Aodha, Jason J. Corso, Amir Vaxman

entry.summary: BiMotion represents character motion using continuous B-spline curves rather than discrete frames, enabling more coherent text-guided 3D character motion generation. Uses a Laplacian-regularized B-spline solver to compress variable-length sequences.

entry.title: Evaluating SAP RPT-1 for Enterprise Business Process Prediction: In-Context Learning vs. Traditional Machine Learning on Structured SAP Data

author.name: Amit Lal (Microsoft Corporation)

entry.summary: First independent evaluation of SAP's RPT-1 tabular foundation model, finding it reaches 91-96% of tuned GBDT accuracy without task-specific training on SAP business scenarios including demand forecasting and financial risk.

entry.title: No Need For Real Anomaly: MLLM Empowered Zero-Shot Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Zunkai Dai, Ke Li, Jiajia Liu, Jie Yang, Yuanyuan Qiao

entry.summary: LAVIDA proposes zero-shot video anomaly detection using pseudo-anomaly generation from segmented objects and MLLM-based semantic comprehension, eliminating the need for real anomaly training data.

entry.title: US-JEPA: A Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Medical Ultrasound

author.name: Ashwath Radhachandran, Vedrana Ivezi\'c, Shreeram Athreya, Ronit Anilkumar, Corey W. Arnold, William Speier

entry.summary: US-JEPA applies Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with a frozen domain-specific teacher (SALT objective) for self-supervised representation learning on ultrasound images, avoiding pixel-level reconstruction issues caused by speckle noise.

entry.title: City Editing: Hierarchical Agentic Execution for Dependency-Aware Urban Geospatial Modification

author.name: Rui Liu, Steven Jige Quan, Zhong-Ren Peng, Zijun Yao, Han Wang, Zhengzhang Chen, Kunpeng Liu, Yanjie Fu, Dongjie Wang

entry.summary: Formulates urban renewal as a machine-executable task using GeoJSON, decomposing natural-language editing instructions into hierarchical geometric operations with dependency-aware execution by an agentic system.

entry.title: Softmax is not Enough (for Adaptive Conformal Classification)

author.name: Navid Akhavan Attar, Hesam Asadollahzadeh, Ling Luo, Uwe Aickelin

entry.summary: Argues that softmax-derived nonconformity scores limit adaptive conformal prediction in deep classifiers, and proposes a new approach to improve adaptiveness of prediction sets beyond softmax limitations.

entry.title: SafePickle: Robust and Generic ML Detection of Malicious Pickle-based ML Models

author.name: Hillel Ohayon, Daniel Gilkarov, Ran Dubin

entry.summary: SafePickle proposes a lightweight ML-based scanner for detecting malicious pickle files distributed through model repositories like Hugging Face, achieving high accuracy without policy generation.

entry.title: LLM-enabled Applications Require System-Level Threat Monitoring

author.name: Yedi Zhang, Haoyu Wang, Xianglin Yang, Jin Song Dong, Jun Sun

entry.summary: Argues that LLM-enabled applications need system-level threat monitoring as a fundamental requirement, treating safety risks as expected operational conditions requiring incident-response infrastructure.

entry.title: AdaWorldPolicy: World-Model-Driven Diffusion Policy with Online Adaptive Learning for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Ge Yuan, Qiyuan Qiao, Jing Zhang, Dong Xu

entry.summary: AdaWorldPolicy integrates world models with diffusion policy for robotic manipulation, enabling online adaptive learning using world model supervision signals complemented by force-torque feedback.

entry.title: Descent-Guided Policy Gradient for Scalable Cooperative Multi-Agent Learning

author.name: Shan Yang, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Descent-Guided Policy Gradient reduces cross-agent noise in cooperative multi-agent RL by incorporating noise-free guidance gradients from differentiable analytical models, decoupling agents' learning signals.

entry.title: Benchmarking Unlearning for Vision Transformers

author.name: Kairan Zhao, Iurie Luca, Peter Triantafillou

entry.summary: First benchmark for machine unlearning in Vision Transformers, evaluating MU algorithms across ViT and Swin-T architectures at different capacities, finding significant behavioral differences from CNNs.

entry.title: To Reason or Not to: Selective Chain-of-Thought in Medical Question Answering

author.name: Zaifu Zhan, Min Zeng, Shuang Zhou, Yiran Song, Xiaoyi Chen, Yu Hou, Yifan Wu, Yang Ruan, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Selective Chain-of-Thought predicts whether medical questions need reasoning before generating rationales, reducing inference time by 13-45% and token usage by 8-47% with minimal accuracy loss on medical QA benchmarks.

entry.title: Insertion Based Sequence Generation with Learnable Order Dynamics

author.name: Dhruvesh Patel, Benjamin Rozonoyer, Gaurav Pandey, Tahira Naseem, Ram\'on Fernandez Astudillo, Andrew McCallum

entry.summary: Incorporates trainable order dynamics into discrete flow matching for insertion-based sequence generation. Shows that joint training of order dynamics and generator is tractable without numerical simulation.

entry.title: VariBASed: Variational Bayes-Adaptive Sequential Monte-Carlo Planning for Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Joery A. de Vries, Jinke He, Yaniv Oren, Pascal R. van der Vaart, Mathijs M. de Weerdt, Matthijs T. J. Spaan

entry.summary: VariBASeD proposes a variational framework combining variational belief learning, sequential Monte-Carlo planning, and meta-RL for Bayes-adaptive MDPs, achieving favorable scaling in single-GPU setups.

entry.title: SLDP: Semi-Local Differential Privacy for Density-Adaptive Analytics

author.name: Alexey Kroshnin, Alexandra Suvorikova

entry.summary: Proposes Semi-Local Differential Privacy (SLDP) that assigns density-adaptive privacy regions to users, decoupling privacy cost from refinement iterations while enabling high-resolution analytics.

entry.title: Spectral bias in physics-informed and operator learning: Analysis and mitigation guidelines

author.name: Siavash Khodakarami, Vivek Oommen, Nazanin Ahmadi Daryakenari, Maxim Beekenkamp, George Em Karniadakis

entry.summary: Provides systematic investigation of spectral bias in PINNs, PIKANs, and neural operators, examining how network architecture, optimization dynamics, and physics-based losses interact to determine frequency learning behavior.

entry.title: AdsorbFlow: energy-conditioned flow matching enables fast and realistic adsorbate placement

author.name: Jiangjie Qiu, Wentao Li, Honghao Chen, Leyi Zhao, Xiaonan Wang

entry.summary: AdsorbFlow uses energy-conditioned flow matching on the rigid-body configuration space for adsorbate placement on catalytic surfaces, reducing sampling from ~100 diffusion steps to a single ODE integration.

entry.title: Addressing Instrument-Outcome Confounding in Mendelian Randomization through Representation Learning

author.name: Shimeng Huang, Matthew Robinson, Francesco Locatello

entry.summary: Proposes a representation learning framework for Mendelian Randomization that uses cross-environment invariance to recover latent exogenous components of genetic instruments, addressing violations of core MR assumptions like population stratification.

entry.title: Asymptotic Semantic Collapse in Hierarchical Optimization

author.name: Faruk Alpay, Bugra Kilictas

entry.summary: Studies 'Asymptotic Semantic Collapse' in multi-agent language systems where a dominant context progressively absorbs individual agent semantics. Models this on a Riemannian manifold and proves convergence properties.

entry.title: DCInject: Persistent Backdoor Attacks via Frequency Manipulation in Personal Federated Learning

author.name: Nahom Birhan, Daniel Wesego, Dereje Shenkut, Frank Liu, Daniel Takabi

entry.summary: Proposes DCInject, a frequency-domain backdoor attack for personalized federated learning that manipulates DC components, revealing that PFL remains vulnerable despite previously being considered naturally resistant.

entry.title: Stochastic Gradient Variational Inference with Price's Gradient Estimator from Bures-Wasserstein to Parameter Space

author.name: Kyurae Kim, Qiang Fu, Yi-An Ma, Jacob R. Gardner, Trevor Campbell

entry.summary: Closes the gap between Wasserstein VI and black-box VI convergence guarantees for Gaussian families, showing identical state-of-the-art iteration complexity. Identifies that WVI's superiority came from Price's gradient estimator, not the measure space formulation.

entry.title: Regularity of Second-Order Elliptic PDEs in Spectral Barron Spaces

author.name: Ziang Chen, Liqiang Huang, Mengxuan Yang, Shengxuan Zhou

entry.summary: Establishes regularity theorems for second-order elliptic PDEs in spectral Barron spaces, identifying a class of PDEs whose solutions can be approximated by two-layer neural networks with dimension-independent width.

entry.title: Relational Feature Caching for Accelerating Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Byunggwan Son, Jeimin Jeon, Jeongwoo Choi, Bumsub Ham

entry.summary: Proposes relational feature caching to accelerate diffusion transformers by exploiting input-output correlations rather than purely temporal extrapolation. Finds that prediction errors in existing caching stem from irregular magnitude changes and that input features strongly correlate with outputs.

entry.title: Closing the gap in multimodal medical representation alignment

author.name: Eleonora Grassucci, Giordano Cicchetti, Danilo Comminiello

entry.summary: Studies the modality gap in CLIP-based medical multimodal alignment, showing it exists in medical settings too. Proposes a modality-agnostic solution to close this gap, improving semantic alignment in medical representation learning.

entry.title: JUCAL: Jointly Calibrating Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty in Classification Tasks

author.name: Jakob Heiss, S\"oren Lambrecht, Jakob Weissteiner, Hanna Wutte, \v{Z}an \v{Z}uri\v{c}, Josef Teichmann, Bin Yu

entry.summary: Proposes JUCAL, a post-calibration method that jointly calibrates aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty for classifier ensembles. Addresses the shortcoming of temperature scaling and conformal methods that don't balance these two uncertainty types.

entry.title: ReHear: Iterative Pseudo-Label Refinement for Semi-Supervised Speech Recognition via Audio Large Language Models

author.name: Zefang Liu, Chenyang Zhu, Sangwoo Cho, Shi-Xiong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ReHear, a framework for semi-supervised ASR that uses an audio-aware LLM to iteratively refine pseudo-labels by conditioning on both ASR hypothesis and source audio, enabling recovery of phonetically accurate transcripts from severe errors.

entry.title: KGHaluBench: A Knowledge Graph-Based Hallucination Benchmark for Evaluating the Breadth and Depth of LLM Knowledge

author.name: Alex Robertson, Huizhi Liang, Mahbub Gani, Rohit Kumar, Srijith Rajamohan

entry.summary: Presents KGHaluBench, a knowledge graph-based hallucination benchmark that assesses LLMs across breadth and depth of knowledge. Uses KG structure to dynamically construct challenging questions with statistical difficulty estimation.

entry.title: LaS-Comp: Zero-shot 3D Completion with Latent-Spatial Consistency

author.name: Weilong Yan, Haipeng Li, Hao Xu, Nianjin Ye, Yihao Ai, Shuaicheng Liu, Jingyu Hu

entry.summary: Introduces LaS-Comp, a zero-shot, training-free 3D shape completion method that leverages 3D foundation model priors through a two-stage design: explicit replacement for geometry preservation and implicit refinement for seamless boundaries. Also introduces Omni-Comp benchmark.

entry.title: HeRO: Hierarchical 3D Semantic Representation for Pose-aware Object Manipulation

author.name: Chongyang Xu, Shen Cheng, Haipeng Li, Haoqiang Fan, Ziliang Feng, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: Presents HeRO, a diffusion-based robotic manipulation policy that combines geometry and semantics via hierarchical semantic fields. Fuses DINOv2 features with Stable Diffusion features for fine-grained, pose-aware object manipulation.

entry.title: Open-Vocabulary Domain Generalization in Urban-Scene Segmentation

author.name: Dong Zhao, Qi Zang, Nan Pu, Wenjing Li, Nicu Sebe, Zhun Zhong

entry.summary: Introduces Open-Vocabulary Domain Generalization in Semantic Segmentation (OVDG-SS), combining open-vocabulary recognition with domain generalization for urban driving. Proposes a framework addressing both unknown categories and domain shifts.

entry.title: A Benchmark and Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Advanced Multimodal Personalization Study

author.name: Xia Hu, Honglei Zhuang, Brian Potetz, Alireza Fathi, Bo Hu, Babak Samari, Howard Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Life-Bench, a multimodal benchmark for advanced personalization study based on simulated user digital footprints, and LifeGraph, a knowledge graph-based framework for organizing personal context. Evaluates VLM personalization capabilities.

entry.title: Direction-aware 3D Large Multimodal Models

author.name: Quan Liu, Weihao Xuan, Junjue Wang, Naoto Yokoya, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu

entry.summary: Proposes direction-aware 3D LMMs by identifying that existing point cloud benchmarks lack ego poses needed for directional question-answering. Introduces PoseRecover pipeline and direction-aware training methodology.

entry.title: ChordEdit: One-Step Low-Energy Transport for Image Editing

author.name: Liangsi Lu, Xuhang Chen, Minzhe Guo, Shichu Li, Jingchao Wang, Yang Shi

entry.summary: Introduces ChordEdit for one-step text-guided image editing by recasting editing as a transport problem between source and target distributions, enabling high-fidelity editing without training or inversion.

entry.title: EMAD: Evidence-Centric Grounded Multimodal Diagnosis for Alzheimer's Disease

author.name: Qiuhui Chen, Xuancheng Yao, Zhenglei Zhou, Xinyue Hu, Yi Hong

entry.summary: Proposes EMAD, a vision-language framework for Alzheimer's diagnosis that generates structured reports with each claim grounded in multimodal evidence through a hierarchical Sentence-Evidence-Anatomy grounding mechanism on 3D brain MRI.

entry.title: Pay Attention to CTC: Fast and Robust Pseudo-Labelling for Unified Speech Recognition

author.name: Alexandros Haliassos, Rodrigo Mira, Stavros Petridis

entry.summary: Proposes CTC-driven teacher forcing for unified speech recognition, where CTC pseudo-labels feed into the decoder for attention targets in a single forward pass. Reduces training cost and improves robustness under distribution shifts compared to autoregressive pseudo-labelling.

entry.title: MICON-Bench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multi-Image Context Image Generation in Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Mingrui Wu, Hang Liu, Jiayi Ji, Xiaoshuai Sun, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Introduces MICON-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating multi-image context generation capabilities of unified multimodal models across six tasks including cross-image composition and identity preservation. Also proposes an MLLM-driven evaluation framework.

entry.title: Accurate Planar Tracking With Robust Re-Detection

author.name: Jonas Serych, Jiri Matas

entry.summary: Presents SAM-H and WOFTSAM, planar trackers combining SAM 2's robust segmentation with homography estimation, achieving significant state-of-the-art improvements on PlanarTrack (+15.2pp) and POT-210 benchmarks.

entry.title: Pixels Don't Lie (But Your Detector Might): Bootstrapping MLLM-as-a-Judge for Trustworthy Deepfake Detection and Reasoning Supervision

author.name: Kartik Kuckreja, Parul Gupta, Muhammad Haris Khan, Abhinav Dhall

entry.summary: Introduces DeepfakeJudge, a framework for evaluating reasoning quality in deepfake detection using bootstrapped generator-evaluator training and reinforcement learning. Addresses the gap between classification accuracy and reasoning fidelity.

entry.title: OVerSeeC: Open-Vocabulary Costmap Generation from Satellite Images and Natural Language

author.name: Rwik Rana, Jesse Quattrociocchi, Dongmyeong Lee, Christian Ellis, Amanda Adkins, Adam Uccello, Garrett Warnell, Joydeep Biswas

entry.summary: Proposes OVerSeeC for generating navigation costmaps from satellite imagery using natural language mission specifications at test time. Combines foundation models for open-vocabulary terrain understanding with compositional traversal logic.

entry.title: PrivacyBench: Privacy Isn't Free in Hybrid Privacy-Preserving Vision Systems

author.name: Nnaemeka Obiefuna, Samuel Oyeneye, Similoluwa Odunaiya, Iremide Oyelaja, Steven Kolawole

entry.summary: Introduces PrivacyBench, a benchmarking framework revealing that combinations of privacy-preserving techniques (e.g., federated learning + differential privacy) can exhibit severe non-additive failures, with accuracy dropping dramatically. Evaluates across ResNet18 and ViT on medical datasets.

entry.title: Infinite-Dimensional Closed-Loop Inverse Kinematics for Soft Robots via Neural Operators

author.name: Carina Veil, Moritz Flaschel, Ellen Kuhl, Cosimo Della Santina

entry.summary: Extends closed-loop inverse kinematics to infinite-dimensional domains for soft robots using neural operators. Composes actuation-to-shape and shape-to-task maps with infinite-dimensional chain rule to reason about entire soft robot shapes.

entry.title: Bellman Value Decomposition for Task Logic in Safe Optimal Control

author.name: William Sharpless, Oswin So, Dylan Hirsch, Sylvia Herbert, Chuchu Fan

entry.summary: Proves that Bellman Values for complex temporal logic tasks can be decomposed into a graph of simpler Bellman Values connected by known equations, including a novel Reach-Avoid-Loop BE. Proposes VDPPO for solving the decomposed problem.

entry.title: Optimal and Structure-Adaptive CATE Estimation with Kernel Ridge Regression

author.name: Seok-Jin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes an optimal algorithm for estimating conditional average treatment effects using kernel ridge regression when the contrast function is simpler than nuisance functions. Achieves minimax rates governed by contrast complexity.

entry.title: Referring Layer Decomposition

author.name: Fangyi Chen, Yaojie Shen, Lu Xu, Ye Yuan, Shu Zhang, Yulei Niu, Longyin Wen

entry.summary: Introduces the Referring Layer Decomposition (RLD) task, which decomposes a single RGB image into complete RGBA layers conditioned on flexible user prompts. Defines a new task bridging compositional understanding and controllable editing.

entry.title: HD-TTA: Hypothesis-Driven Test-Time Adaptation for Safer Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Kartik Jhawar, Lipo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Hypothesis-Driven TTA for brain tumor segmentation, reformulating test-time adaptation as a dynamic decision process with competing geometric hypotheses (compaction vs inflation) to prevent harmful adaptation in safety-critical settings.

entry.title: VALD: Multi-Stage Vision Attack Detection for Efficient LVLM Defense

author.name: Nadav Kadvil, Ayellet Tal

entry.summary: Presents VALD, a training-free multi-stage defense against adversarial attacks on LVLMs that combines image transformations with agentic data consolidation. Uses two-stage detection to efficiently filter clean inputs before invoking expensive LLM-based resolution.

entry.title: Multimodal Dataset Distillation Made Simple by Prototype-Guided Data Synthesis

author.name: Junhyeok Choi, Sangwoo Mo, Minwoo Chae

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-free multimodal dataset distillation framework using prototype-guided data synthesis, avoiding the need for full-dataset training or joint image-text optimization. Enables cross-architecture generalization.

entry.title: Learning to Localize Reference Trajectories in Image-Space for Visual Navigation

author.name: Finn Lukas Busch, Matti Vahs, Quantao Yang, Jes\'us Gerardo Ortega Peimbert, Yixi Cai, Jana Tumova, Olov Andersson

entry.summary: Presents LoTIS, a visual navigation model that provides robot-agnostic image-space guidance by localizing reference trajectories in the current view, without camera calibration or robot-specific training. Enables zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer.

entry.title: PA-Attack: Guiding Gray-Box Attacks on LVLM Vision Encoders with Prototypes and Attention

author.name: Hefei Mei, Zirui Wang, Chang Xu, Jianyuan Guo, Minjing Dong

entry.summary: Introduces PA-Attack, a gray-box adversarial attack targeting vision encoders of LVLMs using prototype-anchored guidance and attention-aware perturbation. Exploits the standardized vision encoder as a cross-model transfer point.

entry.title: ORION: ORthonormal Text Encoding for Universal VLM AdaptatION

author.name: Omprakash Chakraborty, Jose Dolz, Ismail Ben Ayed

entry.summary: Introduces ORION, a text encoder fine-tuning framework for VLMs that promotes orthogonality between class text representations using low-rank adaptation, requiring only class names. Improves discriminability without visual data.

entry.title: ChimeraLoRA: Multi-Head LoRA-Guided Synthetic Datasets

author.name: Hoyoung Kim, Minwoo Jang, Jabin Koo, Sangdoo Yun, Jungseul Ok

entry.summary: Proposes ChimeraLoRA, a multi-head LoRA approach for synthetic data generation that combines image-wise LoRA (fine-grained details) with class-wise LoRA (diversity) through a multi-head architecture for balanced synthetic image generation.

entry.title: SemanticNVS: Improving Semantic Scene Understanding in Generative Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Xinya Chen, Christopher Wewer, Jiahao Xie, Xinting Hu, Jan Eric Lenssen

entry.summary: Presents SemanticNVS, a multi-view diffusion model for novel view synthesis that integrates pre-trained semantic feature extractors to improve generation quality under large camera motions, addressing semantic degradation at distant viewpoints.

entry.title: Decoding ML Decision: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Large-Scale Ranking System

author.name: Longfei Yun, Yihan Wu, Haoran Liu, Xiaoxuan Liu, Ziyun Xu, Yi Wang, Yang Xia, Pengfei Wang, Mingze Gao, Yunxiang Wang, Changfan Chen, Junfeng Pan

entry.summary: Presents GEARS, a framework that reframes large-scale ranking system optimization as autonomous discovery using specialized agent skills that encapsulate ranking expert knowledge. Addresses the bottleneck of translating product intent into executable hypotheses.

entry.title: ALPACA: A Reinforcement Learning Environment for Medication Repurposing and Treatment Optimization in Alzheimer's Disease

author.name: Nolan Brady, Tom Yeh

entry.summary: Presents ALPACA, a Gym-compatible RL environment for exploring personalized Alzheimer's treatment strategies using longitudinal data from ADNI. Enables medication-conditioned simulation of disease progression.

entry.title: Recurrent Structural Policy Gradient for Partially Observable Mean Field Games

author.name: Clarisse Wibault, Johannes Forkel, Sebastian Towers, Tiphaine Wibault, Juan Duque, George Whittle, Andreas Schaab, Yucheng Yang, Chiyuan Wang, Michael Osborne, Benjamin Moll, Jakob Foerster

entry.summary: Proposes Recurrent Structural Policy Gradient (RSPG), the first history-aware hybrid structural method for partially observable mean field games. Scales mean field game algorithms to settings with public information.

entry.title: The Doctor Will (Still) See You Now: On the Structural Limits of Agentic AI in Healthcare

author.name: Gabriela Ar\'anguiz Dias, Kiana Jafari, Allie Griffith, Carolina Ar\'anguiz Dias, Grace Ra Kim, Lana Saadeddin, Mykel J. Kochenderfer

entry.summary: Qualitative study of 20 stakeholders examining structural limits of agentic AI in healthcare, identifying tensions around conceptual fragmentation of 'agentic', accountability structures, and safety/regulatory constraints that make autonomous clinical reasoning currently infeasible.

entry.title: Vibe Coding on Trial: Operating Characteristics of Unanimous LLM Juries

author.name: Muhammad Aziz Ullah, Abdul Serwadda

entry.summary: Studies using unanimous LLM jury committees to verify AI-generated SQL code, benchmarking 15 open models and building committees of 1-6 models that accept code only when all members agree. Addresses the quality control gap in 'vibe coding' workflows.

entry.title: Fairness-Aware Partial-label Domain Adaptation for Voice Classification of Parkinson's and ALS

author.name: Arianna Francesconi, Zhixiang Dai, Arthur Stefano Moscheni, Himesh Morgan Perera Kanattage, Donato Cappetta, Fabio Rebecchi, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi, Rosa Sicilia, Mary-Anne Hartley

entry.summary: Proposes a fairness-aware partial-label domain adaptation framework for voice-based screening of Parkinson's and ALS, addressing cross-device domain shift, partial-label mismatch, and gender-related fairness concerns.

entry.title: Hyperbolic Busemann Neural Networks

author.name: Ziheng Chen, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Nicu Sebe

entry.summary: Lifts multinomial logistic regression and fully connected layers into hyperbolic space via Busemann functions, providing compact parameterization and batch-efficient computation. Demonstrates improvements on hierarchical data tasks.

entry.title: Kaiwu-PyTorch-Plugin: Bridging Deep Learning and Photonic Quantum Computing for Energy-Based Models and Active Sample Selection

author.name: Hongdong Zhu, Qi Gao, Yin Ma, Shaobo Chen, Haixu Liu, Fengao Wang, Tinglan Wang, Chang Wu, Kai Wen

entry.summary: Kaiwu-PyTorch-Plugin bridges deep learning with photonic quantum computing, integrating a Coherent Ising Machine into PyTorch for accelerating Boltzmann sampling and building hybrid quantum-classical architectures.

entry.title: CRCC: Contrast-Based Robust Cross-Subject and Cross-Site Representation Learning for EEG

author.name: Xiaobin Wong, Zhonghua Zhao, Haoran Guo, Zhengyi Liu, Yu Wu, Feng Yan, Zhiren Wang, Sen Song

entry.summary: CRCC addresses cross-site EEG generalization for depression detection by identifying three bias factors and proposing a two-stage training paradigm with contrastive learning and site-adversarial constraints on a standardized multi-site benchmark.

entry.title: Constrained Diffusion for Accelerated Structure Relaxation of Inorganic Solids with Point Defects

author.name: Jingyi Cui, Jacob K. Christopher, Ankita Biswas, Prasanna V. Balachandran, Ferdinando Fioretto

entry.summary: Proposes a constraint-aware diffusion model using primal-dual algorithms for simulating point defects in materials, accelerating structure relaxation compared to first-principles methods.

entry.title: Next Reply Prediction X Dataset: Linguistic Discrepancies in Naively Generated Content

author.name: Simon M\"unker, Nils Schwager, Kai Kugler, Michael Heseltine, Achim Rettinger

entry.summary: Introduces a history-conditioned reply prediction task on X/Twitter data to evaluate linguistic discrepancies between LLM-generated and human-generated social media content, finding significant stylistic differences in naive LLM outputs.

entry.title: FUSAR-GPT : A Spatiotemporal Feature-Embedded and Two-Stage Decoupled Visual Language Model for SAR Imagery

author.name: Xiaokun Zhang, Yi Yang, Ziqi Ye, Baiyun, Xiaorong Guo, Qingchen Fang, Ruyi Zhang, Xinpeng Zhou, Haipeng Wang

entry.summary: FUSAR-GPT develops a visual language model specifically for SAR imagery, constructing a SAR image-text-feature triplet dataset and incorporating a geospatial baseline model as 'world knowledge' for improved interpretation.

entry.title: DGPO: RL-Steered Graph Diffusion for Neural Architecture Generation

author.name: Aleksei Liuliakov, Luca Hermes, Barbara Hammer

entry.summary: DGPO extends RL fine-tuning of graph diffusion models to directed acyclic graphs for neural architecture search, using topological node ordering and positional encoding to preserve edge direction semantics.

entry.title: Safe and Interpretable Multimodal Path Planning for Multi-Agent Cooperation

author.name: Haojun Shi, Suyu Ye, Katherine M. Guerrerio, Jianzhi Shen, Yifan Yin, Daniel Khashabi, Chien-Ming Huang, Tianmin Shu

entry.summary: CaPE proposes a VLM-based multimodal path planning method for multi-agent cooperation where agents use language communication to ensure safety when they cannot predict each other's intentions.

entry.title: Online Navigation Planning for Long-term Autonomous Operation of Underwater Gliders

author.name: Victor-Alexandru Darvariu, Charlotte Z. Reed, Jan Stratmann, Bruno Lacerda, Benjamin Allsup, Stephen Woodward, Elizabeth Siddle, Trishna Saeharaseelan, Owain Jones, Dan Jones, Tobias Ferreira, Chloe Baker, Kevin Chaplin, James Kirk, Ashley Morris, Ryan Patmore, Jeff Polton, Charlotte Williams, Alexandra Kokkinaki, Alvaro Lorenzo Lopez, Justin J. H. Buck, Nick Hawes

entry.summary: Formulates underwater glider navigation as a stochastic shortest-path MDP and proposes an MCTS-based online planner with a physics-informed simulator, validated in real ocean deployments.

entry.title: Smooth Gate Functions for Soft Advantage Policy Optimization

author.name: Egor Denisov, Svetlana Glazyrina, Maksim Kryzhanovskiy, Roman Ischenko

entry.summary: Investigates different smooth gate functions to replace hard clipping in GRPO for LLM training, formalizing properties that admissible gates should satisfy and evaluating several function families.

entry.title: Redefining the Down-Sampling Scheme of U-Net for Precision Biomedical Image Segmentation

author.name: Mingjie Li, Yizheng Chen, Md Tauhidul Islam, Lei Xing

entry.summary: Stair Pooling modifies U-Net's down-sampling by using concatenated small pooling operations in varied orientations to reduce information loss, changing per-step dimensionality reduction from 1/4 to 1/2.

entry.title: Pyramid MoA: A Probabilistic Framework for Cost-Optimized Anytime Inference

author.name: Arindam Khaled

entry.summary: Proposes Pyramid MoA, a hierarchical mixture-of-agents architecture with a lightweight router that escalates queries from small to large LLMs only when needed, achieving 93% on GSM8K while reducing costs significantly.

entry.title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Active Search

author.name: Arundhati Banerjee, Jeff Schneider

entry.summary: Proposes cost-aware diffusion-based active search that replaces expensive tree-based lookahead with a diffusion model for planning search trajectories in partially observable environments.

entry.title: VecFormer: Towards Efficient and Generalizable Graph Transformer with Graph Token Attention

author.name: Jingbo Zhou, Jun Xia, Siyuan Li, Yunfan Liu, Wenjun Wang, Yufei Huang, Changxi Chi, Mutian Hong, Zhuoli Ouyang, Shu Wang, Zhongqi Wang, Xingyu Wu, Chang Yu, Stan Z. Li

entry.summary: VecFormer uses vector quantization in graph transformers for efficient node classification, achieving better generalization in out-of-distribution scenarios with reduced computational complexity.

entry.title: AgenticSum: An Agentic Inference-Time Framework for Faithful Clinical Text Summarization

author.name: Fahmida Liza Piya, Rahmatollah Beheshti

entry.summary: AgenticSum is an inference-time agentic framework for clinical text summarization that separates context selection, generation, verification, and correction stages to reduce hallucinations.

entry.title: Multilingual Large Language Models do not comprehend all natural languages to equal degrees

author.name: Natalia Moskvina, Raquel Montero, Masaya Yoshida, Ferdy Hubers, Paolo Morosi, Walid Irhaymi, Jin Yan, Tamara Serrano, Elena Pagliarini, Fritz G\"unther, Evelina Leivada

entry.summary: Evaluates three multilingual LLMs on language comprehension across 12 typologically diverse languages, finding significant performance disparities beyond the expected English-dominant pattern.

entry.title: StyleStream: Real-Time Zero-Shot Voice Style Conversion

author.name: Yisi Liu, Nicholas Lee, Gopala Anumanchipalli

entry.summary: StyleStream is the first streamable zero-shot voice style conversion system, using a Destylizer and Stylizer (diffusion transformer) pipeline to achieve real-time conversion while preserving linguistic content.

entry.title: MapTab: Can MLLMs Master Constrained Route Planning?

author.name: Ziqiao Shang, Lingyue Ge, Yang Chen, Shi-Yu Tian, Zhenyu Huang, Wenbo Fu, Yu-Feng Li, Lan-Zhe Guo

entry.summary: MapTab benchmarks multimodal LLMs on constrained route planning tasks combining map images with tabular route attributes across metro networks in 160 cities and tourist attractions in 19 countries.

entry.title: Communication-Efficient Personalized Adaptation via Federated-Local Model Merging

author.name: Yinan Zou, Md Kamran Chowdhury Shisher, Christopher G. Brinton, Vishrant Tripathi

entry.summary: Potara is a federated personalization framework that merges global and local LoRA adapters with principled mixing, addressing task heterogeneity in federated fine-tuning of large models with theoretical justification.

entry.title: Boosting for Vector-Valued Prediction and Conditional Density Estimation

author.name: Jian Qian, Shu Ge

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical framework for boosting in vector-valued and conditional density prediction, formalizing (α,β)-boostability and characterizing it under common divergences for geometric median aggregation.

entry.title: Online Realizable Regression and Applications for ReLU Networks

author.name: Ilan Doron-Arad, Idan Mehalel, Elchanan Mossel

entry.summary: Studies realizable online regression under approximate pseudo-metrics, providing a generic potential method that upper bounds the online dimension for function classes including ReLU networks.

entry.title: LEVDA: Latent Ensemble Variational Data Assimilation via Differentiable Dynamics

author.name: Phillip Si, Peng Chen

entry.summary: LEVDA combines ensemble variational data assimilation with pretrained differentiable neural dynamics surrogates, operating in latent space to avoid expensive tangent-linear and adjoint models for geophysical forecasting.

entry.title: Drift Localization using Conformal Predictions

author.name: Fabian Hinder, Valerie Vaquet, Johannes Brinkrolf, Barbara Hammer

entry.summary: Proposes using conformal predictions for concept drift localization - determining which samples are affected by distribution drift. Shows advantages over common local testing approaches in high-dimensional, low-signal settings.

entry.title: Reliable Abstention under Adversarial Injections: Tight Lower Bounds and New Upper Bounds

author.name: Ezra Edelman, Surbhi Goel

entry.summary: Studies online learning with adversarial injections and abstention, establishing tight lower bounds and new upper bounds for combined error. Shows fundamental limits even with oracle access to the underlying distribution.

entry.title: RA-QA: Towards Respiratory Audio-based Health Question Answering

author.name: Gaia A. Bertolino, Yuwei Zhang, Tong Xia, Domenico Talia, Cecilia Mascolo

entry.summary: Creates the first respiratory audio-based question answering dataset by curating 11 diverse respiratory audio datasets, enabling natural language interaction for respiratory health screening.

entry.title: Toward AI Autonomous Navigation for Mechanical Thrombectomy using Hierarchical Modular Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning (HM-MARL)

author.name: Harry Robertshaw, Nikola Fischer, Lennart Karstensen, Benjamin Jackson, Xingyu Chen, S. M. Hadi Sadati, Christos Bergeles, Alejandro Granados, Thomas C Booth

entry.summary: Proposes HM-MARL, a hierarchical modular multi-agent RL framework for autonomous endovascular navigation in mechanical thrombectomy, decomposing guide catheter and guidewire navigation into modular sub-tasks.

entry.title: Federated Measurement of Demographic Disparities from Quantile Sketches

author.name: Arthur Charpentier, Agathe Fernandes Machado, Olivier C\^ot\'e, Fran\c{c}ois Hu

entry.summary: Proposes federated measurement of demographic parity using quantile sketches with Wasserstein-Fréchet variance, proving an ANOVA-style decomposition separating selection effects from cross-silo heterogeneity.

entry.title: MentalBlackboard: Evaluating Spatial Visualization via Mathematical Transformations

author.name: Nilay Yilmaz, Maitreya Patel, Naga Sai Abhiram Kusumba, Yixuan He, Yezhou Yang

entry.summary: Introduces MentalBlackboard, a benchmark for evaluating spatial visualization abilities of Vision-Language Models through paper folding and hole punching tests with prediction and planning tasks.

entry.title: Can a Teenager Fool an AI? Evaluating Low-Cost Cosmetic Attacks on Age Estimation Systems

author.name: Xingyu Shen, Tommy Duong, Xiaodong An, Zengqi Zhao, Zebang Hu, Haoyu Hu, Ziyou Wang, Finn Guo, Simiao Ren

entry.summary: Evaluates whether simple cosmetic modifications (beards, makeup, wrinkles) can fool AI age estimation systems into classifying minors as adults. Uses VLM-simulated physical attacks on 329 facial images and tests 8 models including specialized architectures and vision-language models.

entry.title: Goal-Oriented Influence-Maximizing Data Acquisition for Learning and Optimization

author.name: Weichi Yao, Bianca Dumitrascu, Bryan R. Goldsmith, Yixin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GOIMDA, an active data acquisition algorithm that avoids explicit posterior inference while remaining uncertainty-aware through inverse curvature. Selects inputs by maximizing expected influence on user-specified goal functionals using first-order influence functions.

entry.title: Path-conditioned training: a principled way to rescale ReLU neural networks

author.name: Arthur Lebeurrier, Titouan Vayer, R\'emi Gribonval

entry.summary: Introduces path-conditioned training for ReLU networks that uses a geometrically motivated criterion to rescale parameters, building on the path-lifting framework. Derives an efficient algorithm for parameter alignment that improves training dynamics.

entry.title: Dirichlet Scale Mixture Priors for Bayesian Neural Networks

author.name: August Arnstad, Leiv R{\o}nneberg, Geir Storvik

entry.summary: Proposes Dirichlet Scale Mixture (DSM) priors for Bayesian neural networks that provide structured, sparsity-inducing shrinkage. Derives theoretical dependence structures and shrinkage properties and demonstrates practical benefits.

entry.title: Astra: Activation-Space Tail-Eigenvector Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

author.name: Kainan Liu, Yong Zhang, Ning Cheng, Yun Zhu, Yanmeng Wang, Shaojun Wang, Jing Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes Astra, a PEFT method that leverages tail eigenvectors of model output activations to construct task-adaptive low-rank adapters. Uses a small calibration set to identify underutilized activation subspaces for fine-tuning.

entry.title: Facet-Level Persona Control by Trait-Activated Routing with Contrastive SAE for Role-Playing LLMs

author.name: Wenqiu Tang, Zhen Wan, Takahiro Komamizu, Ichiro Ide

entry.summary: Proposes a contrastive Sparse AutoEncoder framework for facet-level personality control in role-playing LLMs, aligned with the Big Five 30-facet model. Learns personality control vectors without requiring per-persona retraining.

entry.title: Unlocking Multimodal Document Intelligence: From Current Triumphs to Future Frontiers of Visual Document Retrieval

author.name: Yibo Yan, Jiahao Huo, Guanbo Feng, Mingdong Ou, Yi Cao, Xin Zou, Shuliang Liu, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Yu Huang, Jungang Li, Kening Zheng, Xu Zheng, Philip S. Yu, James Kwok, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Presents the first comprehensive survey of Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) in the MLLM era, covering benchmarks, multimodal embedding models, multi-vector models, and vision-language generative models for document retrieval.

entry.title: Deep LoRA-Unfolding Networks for Image Restoration

author.name: Xiangming Wang, Haijin Zeng, Benteng Sun, Jiezhang Cao, Kai Zhang, Qiangqiang Shen, Yongyong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Deep LoRA-Unfolding Networks for image restoration that address limitations of deep unfolding networks by using LoRA-based stage-adaptive proximal mapping modules and a noise-aware routing mechanism for efficient stage-specific denoising.

entry.title: Robust Self-Supervised Cross-Modal Super-Resolution against Real-World Misaligned Observations

author.name: Xiaoyu Dong, Jiahuan Li, Ziteng Cui, Naoto Yokoya

entry.summary: Proposes RobSelf, a fully self-supervised model for cross-modal super-resolution on misaligned data requiring no training data, ground-truth, or pre-alignment. Uses misalignment-aware feature translation and content-aware reference filtering.

entry.title: Spatial-Temporal State Propagation Autoregressive Model for 4D Object Generation

author.name: Liying Yang, Jialun Liu, Jiakui Hu, Chenhao Guan, Haibin Huang, Fangqiu Yi, Chi Zhang, Yanyan Liang

entry.summary: Proposes 4DSTAR, a spatial-temporal state propagation autoregressive model for 4D object generation that maintains temporal-spatial consistency by leveraging outputs from all previous timesteps via dynamic state propagation.

entry.title: Echoes of Ownership: Adversarial-Guided Dual Injection for Copyright Protection in MLLMs

author.name: Chengwei Xia, Fan Ma, Ruijie Quan, Yunqiu Xu, Kun Zhan, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for copyright protection of multimodal large language models by generating trigger images that elicit ownership-related responses exclusively in fine-tuned derivatives of the original model.

entry.title: Similarity-as-Evidence: Calibrating Overconfident VLMs for Interpretable and Label-Efficient Medical Active Learning

author.name: Zhuofan Xie, Zishan Lin, Jinliang Lin, Jie Qi, Shaohua Hong, Shuo Li

entry.summary: Proposes Similarity-as-Evidence (SaE) framework that calibrates VLM text-image similarities using evidential deep learning to address overconfidence in medical active learning, improving sample selection under scarce labeled data.

entry.title: MoBind: Motion Binding for Fine-Grained IMU-Video Pose Alignment

author.name: Duc Duy Nguyen, Tat-Jun Chin, Minh Hoai

entry.summary: Introduces MoBind, a hierarchical contrastive learning framework for aligning IMU signals with 2D pose sequences from video, enabling cross-modal retrieval, temporal synchronization, and action recognition at fine-grained body-part level.

entry.title: Towards Calibrating Prompt Tuning of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ashshak Sharifdeen, Fahad Shamshad, Muhammad Akhtar Munir, Abhishek Basu, Mohamed Insaf Ismithdeen, Jeyapriyan Jeyamohan, Chathurika Sewwandi Silva, Karthik Nandakumar, Muhammad Haris Khan

entry.summary: Proposes a calibration framework for prompt tuning of CLIP that preserves the pretrained embedding space geometry using mean-variance margin penalty and text moment-matching loss to address poor confidence calibration.

entry.title: OpenVO: Open-World Visual Odometry with Temporal Dynamics Awareness

author.name: Phuc D. A. Nguyen, Anh N. Nhu, Ming C. Lin

entry.summary: Introduces OpenVO for open-world visual odometry from uncalibrated monocular dashcam footage with varying observation rates. Handles unseen frequencies and uncalibrated cameras for robust trajectory construction from dashcam videos.

entry.title: L3DR: 3D-aware LiDAR Diffusion and Rectification

author.name: Quan Liu, Xiaoqin Zhang, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu

entry.summary: Proposes L3DR, a 3D-aware LiDAR diffusion and rectification framework that addresses range-view artifacts (depth bleeding, wavy surfaces) by regressing and canceling artifacts in 3D space using point-level offsets.

entry.title: Universal 3D Shape Matching via Coarse-to-Fine Language Guidance

author.name: Qinfeng Xiao, Guofeng Mei, Bo Yang, Liying Zhang, Jian Zhang, Kit-lun Yick

entry.summary: Proposes UniMatch for universal 3D shape matching that uses language guidance in a coarse-to-fine framework to establish dense correspondences between strongly non-isometric shapes across different object categories.

entry.title: Keep it SymPL: Symbolic Projective Layout for Allocentric Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jaeyun Jang, Seunghui Shin, Taeho Park, Hyoseok Hwang
