author.name: Mingxin Yu, Ruixiao Yang, Chuchu Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a structured framework for LLM-driven Automated Heuristic Design that decomposes the process into forward evaluation, backward analytical feedback, and update steps for combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: On sparsity, extremal structure, and monotonicity properties of Wasserstein and Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport plans

author.name: Titouan Vayer (COMPACT)

entry.summary: Provides a self-contained overview of sparsity, extremal structure, and monotonicity properties of Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport plans compared to standard optimal transport.

entry.title: Learning Preference from Observed Rankings

author.name: Yu-Chang Chen, Chen Chian Fuh, Shang En Tsai

entry.summary: Develops a framework for learning consumer preferences from partial rankings using pairwise comparisons with logistic choice probabilities, modeling latent utility as sum of attributes, fixed effects, and low-rank factors while correcting for selection bias.

entry.title: CheckIfExist: Detecting Citation Hallucinations in the Era of AI-Generated Content

author.name: Diletta Abbonato

entry.summary: Presents CheckIfExist, an open-source tool for detecting citation hallucinations in academic papers by cross-referencing against CrossRef, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex databases.

entry.title: MultiCube-RAG for Multi-hop Question Answering

author.name: Jimeng Shi, Wei Hu, Runchu Tian, Bowen Jin, Wonbin Kweon, SeongKu Kang, Yunfan Kang, Dingqi Ye, Sizhe Zhou, Shaowen Wang, Jiawei Han

entry.summary: Proposes MultiCube-RAG for multi-hop question answering, using structured data cubes to capture subject-attribute-relation semantics for iterative retrieval and reasoning.

entry.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Deep Learning-Based LiDAR Super-Resolution for Autonomous Driving

author.name: June Moh Goo, Zichao Zeng, Jan Boehm

entry.summary: First comprehensive survey of deep learning-based LiDAR super-resolution for autonomous driving, organizing methods into CNN-based, model-based unrolling, implicit representations, and other categories.

entry.title: BTReport: A Framework for Brain Tumor Radiology Report Generation with Clinically Relevant Features

author.name: Juampablo E. Heras Rivera, Dickson T. Chen, Tianyi Ren, Daniel K. Low, Asma Ben Abacha, Alberto Santamaria-Pang, Mehmet Kurt

entry.summary: Introduces BTReport, an open-source framework for brain tumor radiology report generation that separates deterministic feature extraction from LLM-based narrative formatting.

entry.title: Benchmarking Adversarial Robustness and Adversarial Training Strategies for Object Detection

author.name: Alexis Winter, Jean-Vincent Martini, Romaric Audigier, Angelique Loesch, Bertrand Luvison

entry.summary: Provides a standardized benchmark for adversarial robustness of object detection models, investigating attack transferability across architectures and the effectiveness of adversarial training strategies including recent diffusion-based purification.

entry.title: Nonparametric Identification and Inference for Counterfactual Distributions with Confounding

author.name: Jianle Sun, Kun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes nonparametric identification and estimation of joint potential outcome distributions under confounding, using conditional copulas for tighter bounds and a causal representation learning framework for unmeasured confounding.

entry.title: AXRP Episode 49 - Caspar Oesterheld on Program Equilibrium

author.name: DanielFilan

entry.summary: A podcast episode featuring Caspar Oesterheld (Carnegie Mellon) discussing program equilibrium — game-theoretic analysis of agents that can read each other's source code and simulate each other. Topics include robust program equilibria, proof-based vs simulation-based approaches, and implications for cooperative AI.

entry.title: Causally-Guided Automated Feature Engineering with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Arun Vignesh Malarkkan, Wangyang Ying, Yanjie Fu

entry.summary: Introduces CAFE, a framework combining causal discovery with multi-agent reinforcement learning for automated feature engineering on tabular data. Groups features by causal influence and uses cascading multi-agent deep Q-learning for feature construction.

entry.title: What Persona Are We Missing? Identifying Unknown Relevant Personas for Faithful User Simulation

author.name: Weiwen Su, Yuhan Zhou, Zihan Wang, Naoki Yoshinaga, Masashi Toyoda

entry.summary: Introduces PICQ, a dataset for identifying unknown but relevant personas in user simulation, revealing a 'Fidelity vs. Insight' dilemma where larger models are more faithful but less insightful about missing personas.

entry.title: CAST: Achieving Stable LLM-based Text Analysis for Data Analytics

author.name: Jinxiang Xie, Zihao Li, Wei He, Rui Ding, Shi Han, Dongmei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CAST, a framework enhancing LLM output stability for text analytics through Algorithmic Prompting and Thinking-before-Speaking, constraining the model's reasoning path for consistent summarization and tagging.

entry.title: NLP Privacy Risk Identification in Social Media (NLP-PRISM): A Survey

author.name: Dhiman Goswami, Jai Kruthunz Naveen Kumar, Sanchari Das

entry.summary: Surveys NLP privacy risks in social media across 203 papers and proposes the NLP-PRISM framework evaluating vulnerabilities across six dimensions including data collection, fairness, and regulatory compliance.

entry.title: A fully differentiable framework for training proxy Exchange Correlation Functionals for periodic systems

author.name: Rakshit Kumar Singh, Aryan Amit Barsainyan, Bharath Ramsundar

entry.summary: Introduces a fully differentiable framework integrating neural network exchange-correlation functionals into DFT for periodic systems, enabling end-to-end gradient flow through self-consistent DFT workflows in PyTorch.

entry.title: ASPEN: Spectral-Temporal Fusion for Cross-Subject Brain Decoding

author.name: Megan Lee, Seung Ha Hwang, Inhyeok Choi, Shreyas Darade, Mengchun Zhang, Kateryna Shapovalenko

entry.summary: Introduces ASPEN, a hybrid architecture combining spectral and temporal EEG features via multiplicative fusion for cross-subject brain-computer interfaces. Demonstrates that spectral features provide more stable cross-subject transfer.

entry.title: The Weight of a Bit: EMFI Sensitivity Analysis of Embedded Deep Learning Models

author.name: Jakub Breier, \v{S}tefan Ku\v{c}er\'ak, Xiaolu Hou

entry.summary: Analyzes vulnerability of embedded neural network models to electromagnetic fault injection attacks across different number representations (32-bit float to 4-bit integer), testing on common image classifiers.

entry.title: AI-Driven Structure Refinement of X-ray Diffraction

author.name: Bin Cao, Qian Zhang, Zhenjie Feng, Taolue Zhang, Jiaqiang Huang, Lu-Tao Weng, Tong-Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WPEM, a physics-constrained whole-pattern decomposition workflow for X-ray diffraction refinement that embeds Bragg's law as an explicit constraint within a batch EM framework.

entry.title: Automated Histopathology Report Generation via Pyramidal Feature Extraction and the UNI Foundation Model

author.name: Ahmet Halici, Ece Tugba Cebeci, Musa Balci, Mustafa Cini, Serkan Sokmen

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical vision-language framework for automated histopathology report generation using the UNI foundation model with multi-resolution pyramidal patch selection from whole slide images.

entry.title: Hardware-accelerated graph neural networks: an alternative approach for neuromorphic event-based audio classification and keyword spotting on SoC FPGA

author.name: Kamil Jeziorek, Piotr Wzorek, Krzysztof Blachut, Hiroshi Nakano, Manon Dampfhoffer, Thomas Mesquida, Hiroaki Nishi, Thomas Dalgaty, Tomasz Kryjak

entry.summary: Presents an FPGA implementation of event-graph neural networks for neuromorphic audio processing, achieving competitive accuracy with 10x fewer parameters than state-of-the-art.

entry.title: Memes-as-Replies: Can Models Select Humorous Manga Panel Responses?

author.name: Ryosuke Kohita, Seiichiro Yoshioka

entry.summary: Introduces the Meme Reply Selection task with MaMe-Re, a benchmark of 100K human-annotated manga panel-social media post pairs, testing whether LLMs can select humorous meme responses.

entry.title: Muon with Spectral Guidance: Efficient Optimization for Scientific Machine Learning

author.name: Binghang Lu, Jiahao Zhang, Guang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes SpecMuon, a spectral-aware optimizer that combines the Muon optimizer's orthogonalized geometry with a mode-wise relaxed scalar auxiliary variable mechanism for physics-informed neural networks and neural operators.

entry.title: ModalImmune: Immunity Driven Unlearning via Self Destructive Training

author.name: Rong Fu, Jia Yee Tan, Wenxin Zhang, Zijian Zhang, Ziming Wang, Zhaolu Kang, Muge Qi, Shuning Zhang, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Presents ModalImmune, a training framework that enforces modality immunity by intentionally collapsing selected modality information during training, making multimodal models robust to missing input channels at deployment.

entry.title: Online Prediction of Stochastic Sequences with High Probability Regret Bounds

author.name: Matthias Frey, Jonathan H. Manton, Jingge Zhu

entry.summary: Presents high-probability regret bounds for universal prediction of stochastic sequences, complementing existing bounds that hold only in expectation. Shows O(T^{-1/2} δ^{-1/2}) convergence rate.

entry.title: Robust Stochastic Gradient Posterior Sampling with Lattice Based Discretisation

author.name: Zier Mensch, Lars Holdijk, Samuel Duffield, Maxwell Aifer, Patrick J. Coles, Max Welling, Miranda C. N. Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Stochastic Gradient Lattice Random Walk (SGLRW), an SGLD variant that introduces noise only through off-diagonal covariance elements, yielding greater robustness to minibatch size while maintaining asymptotic correctness.

entry.title: Exploring New Frontiers in Vertical Federated Learning: the Role of Saddle Point Reformulation

author.name: Aleksandr Beznosikov, Georgiy Kormakov, Alexander Grigorievskiy, Mikhail Rudakov, Ruslan Nazykov, Alexander Rogozin, Anton Vakhrushev, Andrey Savchenko, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Alexander Gasnikov

entry.summary: Explores saddle point reformulation of Vertical Federated Learning via Lagrangian functions, enabling stochastic modifications including compression, partial participation, and coordinate selection for practical VFL scenarios.

entry.title: Local adapt-then-combine algorithms for distributed nonsmooth optimization: Achieving provable communication acceleration

author.name: Luyao Guo, Xinli Shi, Wenying Xu, Jinde Cao

entry.summary: Proposes FlexATC, a communication-efficient distributed optimization framework using probabilistic local updates for composite optimization over networks. Achieves provable communication acceleration with convergence rates decoupled from network topology.

entry.title: Multi-Channel Replay Speech Detection using Acoustic Maps

author.name: Michael Neri, Tuomas Virtanen

entry.summary: Proposes acoustic maps as spatial features for multi-channel replay speech detection, using beamforming-derived directional energy distributions. Achieves competitive performance with only ~6k parameters.

entry.title: Utility-Preserving De-Identification for Math Tutoring: Investigating Numeric Ambiguity in the MathEd-PII Benchmark Dataset

author.name: Zhuqian Zhou, Kirk Vanacore, Bakhtawar Ahtisham, Jinsook Lee, Doug Pietrzak, Daryl Hedley, Jorge Dias, Chris Shaw, Ruth Sch\"afer, Ren\'e F. Kizilcec

entry.summary: Investigates numeric ambiguity in PII detection for math tutoring transcripts, introducing MathEd-PII benchmark. Addresses the problem of over-redacting mathematical content that resembles personal identifiers.

entry.title: Detecting Deepfakes with Multivariate Soft Blending and CLIP-based Image-Text Alignment

author.name: Jingwei Li, Jiaxin Tong, Pengfei Wu

entry.summary: Proposes MSBA-CLIP for deepfake detection, using multivariate soft blending augmentation with CLIP-guided forgery intensity estimation to improve generalization across diverse forgery techniques.

entry.title: DressWild: Feed-Forward Pose-Agnostic Garment Sewing Pattern Generation from In-the-Wild Images

author.name: Zeng Tao, Ying Jiang, Yunuo Chen, Tianyi Xie, Huamin Wang, Yingnian Wu, Yin Yang, Abishek Sampath Kumar, Kenji Tashiro, Chenfanfu Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes DressWild, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs physics-consistent 2D sewing patterns and 3D garments from a single in-the-wild image, using VLMs to normalize pose variations.

entry.title: TurboADMM: A Structure-Exploiting Parallel Solver for Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Yucheng Chen

entry.summary: Introduces TurboADMM, a specialized QP solver for multi-agent trajectory optimization that achieves near-linear complexity in agent count through ADMM decomposition, Riccati-based subproblem solving, and warm-starting.

entry.title: The Impact of Class Uncertainty Propagation in Perception-Based Motion Planning

author.name: Jibran Iqbal Shah, Andrei Ivanovic, Kelly Zhu, Masha Itkina, Rowan McAllister, Igor Gilitschenski, Florian Shkurti

entry.summary: Analyzes how perceptual uncertainty propagation and calibration affect motion planning for autonomous vehicles, comparing prediction-planning pipelines and demonstrating sensitivity to miscalibrated prediction uncertainty.

entry.title: Dual-Quadruped Collaborative Transportation in Narrow Environments via Safe Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhezhi Lei, Zhihai Bi, Wenxin Wang, Jun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes safe reinforcement learning for dual-quadruped collaborative transportation in narrow environments, modeling collision avoidance as constraints in a cooperative Markov game with cost-advantage decomposition.

entry.title: Learning to unfold cloth: Scaling up world models to deformable object manipulation

author.name: Jack Rome, Stephen James, Subramanian Ramamoorthy

entry.summary: Presents an approach to cloth manipulation using a DreamerV2-based world model that learns to unfold cloth from visual observations, addressing the challenge of deformable object manipulation across varying shapes and sizes.

entry.title: How Uncertain Is the Grade? A Benchmark of Uncertainty Metrics for LLM-Based Automatic Assessment

author.name: Hang Li, Kaiqi Yang, Xianxuan Long, Fedor Filippov, Yucheng Chu, Yasemin Copur-Gencturk, Peng He, Cory Miller, Namsoo Shin, Joseph Krajcik, Hui Liu, Jiliang Tang

entry.summary: Benchmarks uncertainty metrics for LLM-based automatic assessment in education, examining how well various uncertainty estimation methods work when LLMs grade student work. Addresses the critical gap between LLM grading capabilities and reliability of confidence estimates.

entry.title: EdgeNav-QE: QLoRA Quantization and Dynamic Early Exit for LAM-based Navigation on Edge Devices

author.name: Mengyun Liu, Shanshan Huang, Jianan Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes EdgeNav-QE, combining QLoRA quantization with dynamic early-exit mechanisms to deploy Large Action Models for real-time navigation on edge devices, achieving significant compression while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Resp-Agent: An Agent-Based System for Multimodal Respiratory Sound Generation and Disease Diagnosis

author.name: Pengfei Zhang, Tianxin Xie, Minghao Yang, Li Liu

entry.summary: Presents Resp-Agent, an autonomous multimodal system for respiratory sound generation and disease diagnosis using a novel Active Adversarial Curriculum Agent that identifies diagnostic weaknesses and schedules targeted synthesis.

entry.title: MaS-VQA: A Mask-and-Select Framework for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

author.name: Xianwei Mao, Kai Ye, Sheng Zhou, Nan Zhang, Haikuan Huang, Bin Li, Jiajun Bu

entry.summary: Proposes MaS-VQA for knowledge-based visual question answering, using a Mask-and-Select mechanism to jointly prune irrelevant image regions and weakly relevant knowledge fragments before reasoning.

entry.title: From Reflection to Repair: A Scoping Review of Dataset Documentation Tools

author.name: Pedro Reynolds-Cu\'ellar (Robotics, AI Institute), Marisol Wong-Villacres (Escuela Superior Polit\'ecnica del Litoral), Adriana Alvarado Garcia (IBM Research), Heila Precel (Robotics, AI Institute)

entry.summary: Reviews 59 dataset documentation tools, identifying four persistent patterns that impede adoption and standardization, analyzing motivations, conceptualizations, and connections to regulations.

entry.title: AI-CARE: Carbon-Aware Reporting Evaluation Metric for AI Models

author.name: KC Santosh, Srikanth Baride, Rodrigue Rizk

entry.summary: Proposes AI-CARE, an evaluation tool for reporting energy consumption and carbon emissions of ML models, introducing a carbon-performance tradeoff metric for more holistic model comparison.

entry.title: SIT-LMPC: Safe Information-Theoretic Learning Model Predictive Control for Iterative Tasks

author.name: Zirui Zang, Ahmad Amine, Nick-Marios T. Kokolakis, Truong X. Nghiem, Ugo Rosolia, Rahul Mangharam

entry.summary: Introduces SIT-LMPC, a safe information-theoretic learning model predictive control algorithm for iterative tasks that uses normalizing flows for value function learning and adaptive penalties for safety.

entry.title: Guide-Guard: Off-Target Predicting in CRISPR Applications

author.name: Joseph Bingham, Netanel Arussy, Saman Zonouz

entry.summary: Presents Guide-Guard, an ML-based system for predicting off-target behavior in CRISPR gene editing with 84% accuracy, trainable across multiple genes.

entry.title: HAWX: A Hardware-Aware FrameWork for Fast and Scalable ApproXimation of DNNs

author.name: Samira Nazari, Mohammad Saeed Almasi, Mahdi Taheri, Ali Azarpeyvand, Ali Mokhtari, Ali Mahani, Christian Herglotz

entry.summary: Presents HAWX, a hardware-aware framework for DNN approximation that uses multi-level sensitivity scoring to guide integration of approximate computing blocks, achieving massive search speedups.

entry.title: Designing Production-Scale OCR for India: Multilingual and Domain-Specific Systems

author.name: Ali Faraz, Raja Kolla, Ashish Kulkarni, Shubham Agarwal

entry.summary: Studies two training strategies for multilingual OCR systems for Indian languages, finding that fine-tuning existing OCR models outperforms training multimodal systems from scratch despite language mismatch.

entry.title: AIFL: A Global Daily Streamflow Forecasting Model Using Deterministic LSTM Pre-trained on ERA5-Land and Fine-tuned on IFS

author.name: Maria Luisa Taccari, Kenza Tazi, Ois\'in M. Morrison, Andreas Grafberger, Juan Colonese, Corentin Carton de Wiart, Christel Prudhomme, Cinzia Mazzetti, Matthew Chantry, Florian Pappenberger

entry.summary: Introduces AIFL, an LSTM-based global streamflow forecasting model using a two-stage training strategy (ERA5-Land pre-training + IFS fine-tuning) to bridge the reanalysis-to-forecast domain shift.

entry.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation of Literature-derived Polymer Knowledge: The Example of a Biodegradable Polymer Expert System

author.name: Sonakshi Gupta, Akhlak Mahmood, Wei Xiong, Rampi Ramprasad

entry.summary: Develops RAG pipelines (VectorRAG and GraphRAG) for polymer science literature, creating a biodegradable polymer expert system that preserves cross-study context for scientific reasoning.

entry.title: Distributed physics-informed neural networks via domain decomposition for fast flow reconstruction

author.name: Yixiao Qian, Jiaxu Liu, Zewei Xia, Song Chen, Chao Xu, Shengze Cai

entry.summary: Proposes a distributed PINNs framework for flow reconstruction with a reference anchor normalization strategy to address pressure indeterminacy in domain-decomposed sub-networks.

entry.title: Fast Online Learning with Gaussian Prior-Driven Hierarchical Unimodal Thompson Sampling

author.name: Tianchi Zhao, He Liu, Hongyin Shi, Jinliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Thompson Sampling with Clustered arms under Gaussian prior for hierarchical multi-armed bandits, proving lower regret bounds by exploiting 2-level structure and unimodal rewards.

entry.title: A Scalable Approach to Solving Simulation-Based Network Security Games

author.name: Michael Lanier, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

entry.summary: Introduces MetaDOAR, a meta-controller for scalable multi-agent RL on large cyber-network environments, combining partition-aware filtering with Q-value caching to enable the Double Oracle/PSRO paradigm at scale.

entry.title: Neighborhood Stability as a Measure of Nearest Neighbor Searchability

author.name: Thomas Vecchiato, Sebastian Bruch

entry.summary: Introduces Clustering-Neighborhood Stability Measure and Point-Neighborhood Stability Measure as analytical tools to determine the suitability of clustering-based approximate nearest neighbor search for a given dataset.

entry.title: Knowledge-Embedded Latent Projection for Robust Representation Learning

author.name: Weijing Tang, Ming Yuan, Zongqi Xia, Tianxi Cai

entry.summary: Proposes knowledge-embedded latent projection that leverages external semantic embeddings (e.g., pre-trained clinical concept embeddings) to improve latent space models for high-dimensional discrete data in imbalanced regimes like EHRs.

entry.title: Empirical Cumulative Distribution Function Clustering for LLM-based Agent System Analysis

author.name: Chihiro Watanabe, Jingyu Sun

entry.summary: Proposes an evaluation framework for LLM-based agent systems using empirical cumulative distribution functions (ECDF) of cosine similarities between generated and reference answers. This provides more nuanced assessment than majority voting or exact match metrics.

entry.title: RefineFormer3D: Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation via Adaptive Multi-Scale Transformer with Cross Attention Fusion

author.name: Kavyansh Tyagi, Vishwas Rathi, Puneet Goyal

entry.summary: Proposes RefineFormer3D, a lightweight hierarchical transformer for 3D medical image segmentation using GhostConv3D patch embedding, MixFFN3D with low-rank projections, and cross-attention fusion.

entry.title: Optimizing Soft Prompt Tuning via Structural Evolution

author.name: Zhenzhen Huang, Chaoning Zhang, Haoyu Bian, Songbo Zhang, Chi-lok Andy Tai, Jiaquan Zhang, Caiyan Qin, Jingjing Qu, Yalan Ye, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes optimizing soft prompt tuning using persistent homology from topological data analysis to quantify structural representations and their evolution during training.

entry.title: LAND: A Longitudinal Analysis of Neuromorphic Datasets

author.name: Gregory Cohen, Alexandre Marcireau

entry.summary: Comprehensive longitudinal analysis of neuromorphic datasets over the past decade, documenting the state of available datasets, their challenges, and the gap between data needs and availability.

entry.title: PredMapNet: Future and Historical Reasoning for Consistent Online HD Vectorized Map Construction

author.name: Bo Lang, Nirav Savaliya, Zhihao Zheng, Jinglun Feng, Zheng-Hang Yeh, Mooi Choo Chuah

entry.summary: Introduces PredMapNet for consistent online HD vectorized map construction for autonomous driving, combining map instance tracking with short-term prediction using semantic-aware query initialization and temporal reasoning.

entry.title: From Conflicts to Collisions: A Two-Stage Collision Scenario-Testing Approach for Autonomous Driving Systems

author.name: Siyuan Chen, Fuyuan Zhang, Hua Qi, Lei Ma, Tomoyuki Tsuchiya, Michio Hayashi, Manabu Okada

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage scenario testing framework for autonomous driving that first searches for traffic conflicts as intermediate targets, then mutates these into actual collision scenarios, improving test coverage of hazardous situations.

entry.title: World Model Failure Classification and Anomaly Detection for Autonomous Inspection

author.name: Michelle Ho, Muhammad Fadhil Ginting, Isaac R. Ward, Andrzej Reinke, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Ali-akbar Agha-Mohammadi, Shayegan Omidshafiei

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid framework combining supervised failure classification with anomaly detection for autonomous inspection robots, using world models with conformal prediction thresholds for distribution-free guarantees.

entry.title: System Identification under Constraints and Disturbance: A Bayesian Estimation Approach

author.name: Sergi Martinez, Steve Tonneau, Carlos Mastalli

entry.summary: Introduces a Bayesian system identification framework for jointly estimating robot trajectories and physical parameters with physically consistent constraints, friction models, and energy-based regressors.

entry.title: Monthly Roundup #39: February 2026

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's monthly roundup covering the Anthropic-Pentagon situation, discussing how LLMs cannot be treated as deterministic tools and the challenges of military AI deployment requiring testing similar to human soldier training.

entry.title: Language Model Representations for Efficient Few-Shot Tabular Classification

author.name: Inwon Kang, Parikshit Ram, Yi Zhou, Horst Samulowitz, Oshani Seneviratne

entry.summary: Investigates using LLM representations for few-shot classification of web-native tabular data, exploring whether already-deployed LLMs can classify structured data without specialized models.

entry.title: AI as Teammate or Tool? A Review of Human-AI Interaction in Decision Support

author.name: Most. Sharmin Sultana Samu, Nafisa Khan, Kazi Toufique Elahi, Tasnuva Binte Rahman, Md. Rakibul Islam, Farig Sadeque

entry.summary: Reviews Human-AI Interaction literature across four dimensions, finding that static interfaces and miscalibrated trust limit AI efficacy, with a 'fluency trap' that inflates trust without improving decision-making.

entry.title: Playing With AI: How Do State-Of-The-Art Large Language Models Perform in the 1977 Text-Based Adventure Game Zork?

author.name: Berry Gerrits

entry.summary: Evaluates ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini on the classic 1977 text adventure game Zork, finding all models achieve less than 10% completion, exposing limitations in multi-step reasoning and spatial navigation.

entry.title: IT-OSE: Exploring Optimal Sample Size for Industrial Data Augmentation

author.name: Mingchun Sun, Rongqiang Zhao, Zhennan Huang, Songyu Ding, Jie Liu

entry.summary: Proposes IT-OSE, an information-theoretic method for estimating optimal sample size in industrial data augmentation, with theoretical analysis of the relationship between OSS and dominant factors.

entry.title: NeuroSleep: Neuromorphic Event-Driven Single-Channel EEG Sleep Staging for Edge-Efficient Sensing

author.name: Boyu Li, Xingchun Zhu, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroSleep, a neuromorphic event-driven system for energy-efficient EEG-based sleep staging on edge devices, using event-driven sensing and spiking neural networks.

entry.title: Temporal Panel Selection in Ongoing Citizens' Assemblies

author.name: Yusuf Hakan Kalayci, Evi Micha

entry.summary: Formalizes temporal panel selection for permanent citizens' assemblies, requiring proportional representation both within individual panels and across sequences of panels over time.

entry.title: UCTECG-Net: Uncertainty-aware Convolution Transformer ECG Network for Arrhythmia Detection

author.name: Hamzeh Asgharnezhad, Pegah Tabarisaadi, Abbas Khosravi, Roohallah Alizadehsani, U. Rajendra Acharya

entry.summary: Proposes UCTECG-Net, a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture for ECG arrhythmia detection with uncertainty quantification, achieving up to 99.14% accuracy on standard benchmarks.

entry.title: IndicEval: A Bilingual Indian Educational Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models

author.name: Saurabh Bharti, Gaurav Azad, Abhinaw Jagtap, Nachiket Tapas

entry.summary: Introduces IndicEval, a benchmarking platform for LLMs using real Indian examination questions (UPSC, JEE, NEET) in English and Hindi, testing reasoning and bilingual capabilities.

entry.title: A Koopman-Bayesian Framework for High-Fidelity, Perceptually Optimized Haptic Surgical Simulation

author.name: Rohit Kaushik, Eva Kaushik

entry.summary: Combines Koopman operator theory with Bayesian perceptual calibration for haptic surgical simulation, allowing linear prediction of nonlinear tissue dynamics while matching human perceptual limits.

entry.title: On the Power of Source Screening for Learning Shared Feature Extractors

author.name: Leo (Muxing), Wang, Connor Mclaughlin, Lili Su

entry.summary: Studies which data sources should be jointly learned for shared feature extraction, focusing on source screening in the linear setting. Shows that even among 'good' sources, careful selection matters for representation learning.

entry.title: Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework for Time Series Forecasting and Classification

author.name: Xu Zhang, Peng Wang, Yichen Li, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes APTF, a general framework that identifies and penalizes low-predictability samples during training for both time series forecasting and classification tasks, improving robustness to noisy training data.

entry.title: FEKAN: Feature-Enriched Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Sidharth S. Menon, Ameya D. Jagtap

entry.summary: Introduces Feature-Enriched KANs (FEKAN), extending Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with feature enrichment to improve computational efficiency and accuracy without increasing trainable parameters.

entry.title: Transfer Learning of Linear Regression with Multiple Pretrained Models: Benefiting from More Pretrained Models via Overparameterization Debiasing

author.name: Daniel Boharon, Yehuda Dar

entry.summary: Studies transfer learning with multiple overparameterized pretrained linear regression models, showing that using sufficiently many pretrained models can overcome overparameterization bias through debiasing.

entry.title: The Validity of Coreference-based Evaluations of Natural Language Understanding

author.name: Ian Porada

entry.summary: A thesis examining the validity of coreference-based evaluations of NLU, showing measurement validity issues including contestedness and lack of convergent validity across benchmarks.

entry.title: Label-Consistent Data Generation for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis Using LLM Agents

author.name: Mohammad H. A. Monfared, Lucie Flek, Akbar Karimi

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic data augmentation method for aspect-based sentiment analysis using iterative generation and verification with LLM agents, compared against a matched prompting baseline.

entry.title: Automated Re-Identification of Holstein-Friesian Cattle in Dense Crowds

author.name: Phoenix Yu, Tilo Burghardt, Andrew W Dowsey, Neill W Campbell

entry.summary: Proposes a detect-segment-identify pipeline for re-identifying Holstein-Friesian cattle in dense crowds using SAM and open-vocabulary detection, with a new 9-day CCTV dataset from a working dairy farm.

entry.title: Arc2Morph: Identity-Preserving Facial Morphing with Arc2Face

author.name: Nicol\`o Di Domenico, Annalisa Franco, Matteo Ferrara, Davide Maltoni

entry.summary: Proposes Arc2Morph, a face morphing technique based on the Arc2Face foundation model that creates photorealistic morphed faces from compact identity representations, demonstrating vulnerability in electronic identity document systems.

entry.title: TeCoNeRV: Leveraging Temporal Coherence for Compressible Neural Representations for Videos

author.name: Namitha Padmanabhan, Matthew Gwilliam, Abhinav Shrivastava

entry.summary: Introduces TeCoNeRV for video compression using implicit neural representations, with temporal coherence exploitation. Achieves 20x reduction in pretraining memory and demonstrates strong compression performance via hypernetwork-based weight prediction.

entry.title: Evolutionary Systems Thinking -- From Equilibrium Models to Open-Ended Adaptive Dynamics

author.name: Dan Adler

entry.summary: Introduces Stability-Driven Assembly (SDA), a minimal non-equilibrium framework where stochastic interactions with differential persistence generate endogenous selection without genes or fitness functions, bridging evolutionary dynamics with systems thinking.

entry.title: VGGT-based online 3D semantic SLAM for indoor scene understanding and navigation

author.name: Anna Gelencs\'er-Horv\'ath, Gergely Dinya, Dorka Bogl\'arka Er\H{o}s, P\'eter Hal\'asz, Islam Muhammad Muqsit, Krist\'of Karacs

entry.summary: Presents SceneVGGT, a 3D scene understanding framework combining SLAM with semantic mapping using the VGGT foundation model, scaling to long video streams via sliding windows while maintaining GPU memory under 17GB.

entry.title: Reactive Slip Control in Multifingered Grasping: Hybrid Tactile Sensing and Internal-Force Optimization

author.name: Th\'eo Ayral, Saifeddine Aloui, Mathieu Grossard

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid learning and model-based approach for reactive slip control in multi-fingered robotic grasping, combining piezoelectric slip detection with internal force optimization achieving 20ms slip detection latency.

entry.title: Quantifying and Attributing Submodel Uncertainty in Stochastic Simulation Models and Digital Twins

author.name: Mohammadmahdi Ghasemloo, David J. Eckman, Yaxian Li

entry.summary: Develops a framework for quantifying how epistemic uncertainty from estimated or learned submodel approximations affects system performance metrics in stochastic simulation and digital twins.

entry.title: Alignment Is Proven Tractable

author.name: SE Gyges

entry.summary: Argues that AI alignment has been proven tractable based on observed progress with current systems, challenging the narrative that alignment is an unsolvable problem. Reviews historical quotes predicting alignment difficulty alongside current successes.

entry.title: Managed vs Unmanaged Agency

author.name: plex

entry.summary: Proposes replacing the instrumental/terminal goals distinction with a 'managed vs unmanaged agency' spectrum, where subagents spawned by a parent cognitive process can be more or less tightly supervised. The framework argues this better captures how hierarchical goal structures actually work and how trust-based delegation avoids pitfalls of rigid goal hierarchies.

entry.title: Structured Unitary Tensor Network Representations for Circuit-Efficient Quantum Data Encoding

author.name: Guang Lin, Toshihisa Tanaka, Qibin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes TNQE, a circuit-efficient quantum data encoding framework using structured unitary tensor network representations, with trainable compilation from tensor cores to quantum circuits.

entry.title: Nonplanar Model Predictive Control for Autonomous Vehicles with Recursive Sparse Gaussian Process Dynamics

author.name: Ahmad Amine, Kabir Puri, Viet-Anh Le, Rahul Mangharam

entry.summary: Proposes a nonplanar MPC framework for autonomous vehicles on 3D terrain using recursive sparse Gaussian Processes to learn residual dynamics, validated in Isaac Sim.

entry.title: Markerless Robot Detection and 6D Pose Estimation for Multi-Agent SLAM

author.name: Markus Rueggeberg, Maximilian Ulmer, Maximilian Durner, Wout Boerdijk, Marcus Gerhard Mueller, Rudolph Triebel, Riccardo Giubilato

entry.summary: Proposes markerless robot detection and 6D pose estimation for multi-agent SLAM, replacing traditional fiducial marker arrays for inter-robot observation in collaborative mapping.

entry.title: Can LLMs Assess Personality? Validating Conversational AI for Trait Profiling

author.name: Andrius Mat\v{s}enas, Anet Lello, T\~onis Lees, Hans Peep, Kim Lilii Tamm

entry.summary: Validates LLMs as alternatives to questionnaire-based Big Five personality assessment through a within-subjects experiment (N=33), finding moderate convergent validity (r=0.38-0.58) with trait-specific calibration needed.

entry.title: DataJoint 2.0: A Computational Substrate for Agentic Scientific Workflows

author.name: Dimitri Yatsenko (DataJoint Inc., Houston, USA), Thinh T. Nguyen (DataJoint Inc., Houston, USA)

entry.summary: Presents DataJoint 2.0, a relational workflow model for scientific data pipelines that provides transactional guarantees and machine-readable provenance, designed for human-agent collaboration.

entry.title: A Contrastive Learning Framework Empowered by Attention-based Feature Adaptation for Street-View Image Classification

author.name: Qi You, Yitai Cheng, Zichao Zeng, James Haworth

entry.summary: Proposes CLIP-MHAdapter for street-view image classification, using multi-head attention to capture fine-grained local features from CLIP, improving over global embedding approaches.

entry.title: Adaptive Semi-Supervised Training of P300 ERP-BCI Speller System with Minimum Calibration Effort

author.name: Shumeng Chen, Jane E. Huggins, Tianwen Ma

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive semi-supervised EM-GMM framework for P300 BCI spellers that minimizes calibration effort while maintaining performance through iterative classifier updating.

entry.title: P-RAG: Prompt-Enhanced Parametric RAG with LoRA and Selective CoT for Biomedical and Multi-Hop QA

author.name: Xingda Lyu, Gongfu Lyu, Zitai Yan, Yuxin Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes P-RAG, a hybrid RAG architecture integrating parametric knowledge with retrieved evidence, guided by Chain-of-Thought prompting and LoRA fine-tuning, evaluated on biomedical and multi-hop QA.

entry.title: Emotion Collider: Dual Hyperbolic Mirror Manifolds for Sentiment Recovery via Anti Emotion Reflection

author.name: Rong Fu, Ziming Wang, Shuo Yin, Wenxin Zhang, Haiyun Wei, Kun Liu, Xianda Li, Zeli Su, Simon Fong

entry.summary: Presents EC-Net, a hyperbolic hypergraph framework for multimodal emotion and sentiment modeling using Poincaré-ball embeddings and contrastive learning in hyperbolic space.

entry.title: From Transcripts to AI Agents: Knowledge Extraction, RAG Integration, and Robust Evaluation of Conversational AI Assistants

author.name: Krittin Pachtrachai, Petmongkon Pornpichitsuwan, Wachiravit Modecrua, Touchapon Kraisingkorn

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end framework for building conversational AI assistants from historical call transcripts, including transcript quality grading, knowledge extraction, and RAG-based response generation.

entry.title: EasyControlEdge: A Foundation-Model Fine-Tuning for Edge Detection

author.name: Hiroki Nakamura, Hiroto Iino, Masashi Okada, Tadahiro Taniguchi

entry.summary: Proposes EasyControlEdge, which adapts image-generation foundation models for edge detection tasks. The method addresses crispness and data efficiency in real-world edge detection applications like floor-plan walls, satellite imagery, and medical imaging boundaries.

entry.title: Reactive Motion Generation With Particle-Based Perception in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Xiyuan Zhao, Huijun Li, Lifeng Zhu, Zhikai Wei, Xianyi Zhu, Aiguo Song

entry.summary: Proposes a reactive motion generation framework combining tensorized particle-based dynamic obstacle mapping with MPPI-based planning for robot manipulators in dynamic environments.

entry.title: Narrative Theory-Driven LLM Methods for Automatic Story Generation and Understanding: A Survey

author.name: David Y. Liu, Aditya Joshi, Paul Dawson

entry.summary: Surveys how NLP research engages with narrative studies, proposing a taxonomy for LLM-based story generation and understanding that reflects established narratology distinctions.

entry.title: Enhancing Action and Ingredient Modeling for Semantically Grounded Recipe Generation

author.name: Guoshan Liu, Bin Zhu, Yian Li, Jingjing Chen, Chong-Wah Ngo, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a semantically grounded framework for recipe generation from food images combining SFT with reinforcement fine-tuning, using frequency-aware rewards to improve action prediction and ingredient generalization.

entry.title: Hybrid Model Predictive Control with Physics-Informed Neural Network for Satellite Attitude Control

author.name: Carlo Cena, Mauro Martini, Marcello Chiaberge

entry.summary: Explores Physics-Informed Neural Networks for spacecraft attitude dynamics modeling and integrates them with Model Predictive Control, comparing against conventional data-driven approaches.

entry.title: ODYN: An All-Shifted Non-Interior-Point Method for Quadratic Programming in Robotics and AI

author.name: Jose Rojas, Aristotelis Papatheodorou, Sergi Martinez, Ioannis Havoutis, Carlos Mastalli

entry.summary: Introduces ODYN, a novel quadratic programming solver combining all-shifted NCP functions with proximal methods, targeting robotics and AI applications with strong warm-start performance.

entry.title: A Self-Supervised Approach for Enhanced Feature Representations in Object Detection Tasks

author.name: Santiago C. Vilabella, Pablo P\'erez-N\'u\~nez, Beatriz Remeseiro

entry.summary: Demonstrates that self-supervised pre-training of feature extractors can improve object detection performance with less labeled data, showing practical benefits on PASCAL VOC.

entry.title: BamaER: A Behavior-Aware Memory-Augmented Model for Exercise Recommendation

author.name: Qing Yang, Yuhao Jiang, Rui Wang, Jipeng Guo, Yejiang Wang, Xinghe Cheng, Zezheng Wu, Jiapu Wang, Jingwei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes BamaER, a behavior-aware memory-augmented framework for exercise recommendation that captures rich behavioral interactions beyond simple exercise sequences.

entry.title: Investigating GNN Convergence on Large Randomly Generated Graphs with Realistic Node Feature Correlations

author.name: Mohammed Zain Ali Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces a method to generate random graphs with correlated node features to better study GNN convergence, arguing existing studies unrealistically assume uncorrelated features. Tests GNN expressive power on more realistic synthetic graphs.

entry.title: SEMixer: Semantics Enhanced MLP-Mixer for Multiscale Mixing and Long-term Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Xu Zhang, Qitong Wang, Peng Wang, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SEMixer for long-term time series forecasting with a Random Attention Mechanism for patch-level semantics and Multiscale Progressive Mixing Chain for multi-scale dependency modeling.

entry.title: Small molecule retrieval from tandem mass spectrometry: what are we optimizing for?
